questions.e: درست ترجمہ: فنڈز بروقت جاری نہ ہوئے تو منصوبہ تاخیر کا شکار ہو جائے گا۔

questions.q: “مرک بِ حال و ذوالحال” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: تمیز وہ اسم جو شک دور کرے، اور ممیز وہ ہے جس کے لیے شک دور کیا جائے۔
ایک بے معنی لفظ اور ایک بامعنی لفظ پر مشتمل۔
جس میں حال (وصفی کیفیت) اور اس کا حامل ساتھ ہوں۔
اسم اور اسمِ اشارہ پر مشتمل ترکیب۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 214: مرک بِ حال و ذوالحال — جس میں حال (وصفی کیفیت) اور اس کا حامل ساتھ ہوں۔

questions.q: یہ تعریف کس اصطلاح کی ہے؟ “وہ حروف جن میں نرمی ہو، آواز کو لمبا کرتے ہیں یا کمزور تلفظ رکھتے ہیں”
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 212: حرو فِ علت — وہ حروف جن میں نرمی ہو، آواز کو لمبا کرتے ہیں یا کمزور تلفظ رکھتے ہیں

questions.q: «حاضر» کا متضاد کون سا ہے؟
questions.e: حاضر موجود اور غائب غیر موجود شخص کو کہتے ہیں۔

questions.q: «قریب» کا متضاد کون سا ہے؟
questions.e: قریب کے مقابل بعید یعنی دور ہے۔

questions.q: محاورہ «رنگ میں بھنگ ڈالنا» کا مطلب کیا ہے؟
questions.e: رنگ میں بھنگ ڈالنا اچھے ماحول یا کام کو خراب کرنا ہے۔

questions.q: محاورہ «ایک آنکھ نہ بھانا» کا مطلب کیا ہے؟
questions.e: ایک آنکھ نہ بھانا شدید ناپسندیدگی ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

questions.q: دو یا دو سے زیادہ الفاظ کے مجموعے کو _____ کہا جاتا ہے۔
Preposterous کا درست ترجمہ کیا ہے؟
یہ تعریف کس اصطلاح کی ہے؟ “وہ حرف یا حرکت جو موجود تو ہو مگر تلفظ میں نہ آئے۔”
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 213: محذوف — وہ حرف یا حرکت جو موجود تو ہو مگر تلفظ میں نہ آئے۔

questions.q: “صوت” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: وہ اسم جو آواز یا اس سے مشابہت رکھنے والی شے کو ظاہر کرے۔
وہ اسم جو کسی چیز کی کثرت یا مقدار ظاہر کرے۔
وہ مسدر جس کا فعل صرف فاعل کو چاہیے، یعنی اس کا اثر صرف کرنے والے پر ہوتا ہے۔
وہ مسدر جس کا فعل فاعل اور مفعول دونوں کو چاہیے، یعنی اس کا اثر دوسرے پر بھی پڑتا ہے۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 209: صوت — وہ اسم جو آواز یا اس سے مشابہت رکھنے والی شے کو ظاہر کرے۔

questions.q: ان اصطلاحات—کنایہ، جملے کی تعریف، جملے کے عناصر، بڑے جزو—میں درست اصطلاح اور تعریف کا جوڑا منتخب کریں۔
o: بڑے جزو — ایسے الفاظ کا مجموعہ جو مکمل مفہوم دے۔
کنایہ — ایسا اندازِ بیان جس میں کوئی بات بالواسطہ کہی جائے مگر اس کا مطلب سمجھا جائے۔
جملے کی تعریف — خبر + )جس کے بارے میں بات ہو(مبتدا )جو بات کی جائے(
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 216: کنایہ — ایسا اندازِ بیان جس میں کوئی بات بالواسطہ کہی جائے مگر اس کا مطلب سمجھا جائے۔

questions.q: “اسمِ موصول” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: وہ اسم جو کسی شخص کو عزت یا احترام سے پکارنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔
وہ اسم جو کسی شخص کو کسی خاص خصوصیت یا حیثیت کی وجہ سے دیا جاتا ہے۔
وہ اسم جو کسی شخص کے والد یا بچوں کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے۔
وہ اسم جو کسی جملے یا فقرے کے ساتھ منسلک ہوتا ہو اور مکمل معنی تب تک نہیں دیتا جب تک کہ دوسرا جملہ اس کے ساتھ نہ ہو۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 209: اسمِ موصول — وہ اسم جو کسی جملے یا فقرے کے ساتھ منسلک ہوتا ہو اور مکمل معنی تب تک نہیں دیتا جب تک کہ دوسرا جملہ اس کے ساتھ نہ ہو۔

questions.q: تعریف “جو ماضی میں کسی مدت تک جاری رہا ہو۔” اور مثال “وہ رات بھر پڑھتا رہا، بارش ہو رہی تھی” کس اصطلاح کو ظاہر کرتی ہیں؟
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 211: ماضی استمراری — جو ماضی میں کسی مدت تک جاری رہا ہو۔

questions.q: “محاورہ” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: کسی چیز کو کسی دوسری چیز کے مشابہ قرار دینا جس میں دونوں کے درمیان کوئی مشترک خوبی ہو۔
ایک جملہ یا قول جو زندگی کے تجربات یا سچائیوں کو سادہ اور اثر دار انداز میں بیان کرتا ہے۔
وہ جملے یا الفاظ جو روزانہ کی بات چیت میں معمولی طور پر استعمال ہوتے ہیں، جن کا مطلب صاف اور واضح ہوتا ہے۔
ایسا جملہ یا اظہار جس کا لغوی مطلب نہیں ہوتا، بلکہ ثقافتی یا لسانی پس منظر میں مخصوص معنی رکھتا ہے۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 215: محاورہ — ایسا جملہ یا اظہار جس کا لغوی مطلب نہیں ہوتا، بلکہ ثقافتی یا لسانی پس منظر میں مخصوص معنی رکھتا ہے۔

questions.q: “اسمِ مشتق” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: جو کسی اور لفظ (خاص طور پر مصدر) سے بنا ہو
جو کسی حقیقی وجود رکھنے والی چیز یا فرد پر دلالت کرے
وہ اسم جس میں مصدر کی کیفیت یا اثر پایا جائے
جو کسی کام کو کرنے والے پر دلالت کرے (مصدر سے بنا ہو)
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 208: اسمِ مشتق — جو کسی اور لفظ (خاص طور پر مصدر) سے بنا ہو

questions.q: “مرک بِ عددی” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: دو یا زائد الفاظ کو "و" یا کسی اور حرفِ عطف سے مالیا جائے۔
دو اسم یا الفاظ اس طرح جُڑ جائیں کہ الگ نہ کیے جا سکیں۔
عدد اور اسم پر مشتمل ترکیب۔
جس میں حال (وصفی کیفیت) اور اس کا حامل ساتھ ہوں۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 214: مرک بِ عددی — عدد اور اسم پر مشتمل ترکیب۔

questions.q: تعریف “حرکت کو لمبا کر کے پڑھنا” اور مثال “لہو" کو "لوہو"” کس اصطلاح کو ظاہر کرتی ہیں؟
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 213: اشباع — حرکت کو لمبا کر کے پڑھنا

questions.q:
Read the passage: “A clinic tested a new appointment reminder. Missed visits declined, but the trial included only patients who had supplied phone numbers. The manager refused to claim that reminders would help all patients equally.”

What limits the manager’s conclusion?
o: Patients without phone numbers were not included
questions.e: The sample excluded patients without a phone number.

questions.q:
Read the passage: “A clinic tested a new appointment reminder. Missed visits declined, but the trial included only patients who had supplied phone numbers. The manager refused to claim that reminders would help all patients equally.”

The manager’s refusal to generalise is an example of:
o: Caution about the representativeness of a sample
questions.e: Results from a selected group cannot automatically be extended to everyone.

questions.q: Forty winks means:
o: A short nap or brief period of sleep
questions.e: “Forty winks” is an idiom for a brief sleep or nap.

questions.q: 'Argus-eyed' means:
questions.e: “Argus-eyed” means watchful or keenly observant.

questions.q: "To have a chip on one's shoulder" means:
o: To carry a piece of wood.
questions.e: A person with a chip on their shoulder carries a grievance or resentment.

questions.q: In the sentence "Ambition urges me forward", 'forward' is:
questions.e: “Forward” modifies “urges” and indicates direction, so it functions as an adverb.

questions.q: Identify the antonym of Vitriolic.
questions.e: “Vitriolic” describes bitter, harsh speech; “amiable” describes a friendly manner.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The quality of the answers submitted by the candidates were disappointing.”?
o: The quality of the answers submitted by the candidates was disappointing.
The quality of the answers submitted by the candidates were disappointing.
The quality of the answers submitted by the candidates was not disappointing.
The quality of the answers submitted by the candidates was disappointing without.
questions.e: Strip the phrases: quality … was. The head noun is quality, which is singular.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The judiciary defended the constitution. (It-cleft.)”?
o: It was the judiciary that defended the constitution.
It was not the judiciary that defended the constitution.
It were the judiciary that defended the constitution.
questions.e: It was the judiciary that defended the constitution. (It-cleft Day 23.)

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Examples (with Prepositions Highlighted) “She lives at 16 Khan Colony.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 232: Rule “Specific address” corresponds to Examples (with Prepositions Highlighted) “She lives at 16 Khan Colony.”.

questions.q: Which Sentence Type is associated with Clause Structure “Two or More ndependent Clauses + One or More Dependent Clauses” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 234: Sentence Type “Compound- Complex Sentence” corresponds to Clause Structure “Two or More ndependent Clauses + One or More Dependent Clauses”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Sentence Example “He is tall.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Linking Verb” corresponds to Sentence Example “He is tall.”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “After reviewing the report, the recommendations were accepted.”?
o: After reviewing the report, the committee accepted the recommendations not.
After reviewing the report, the recommendations were accepted.
After reviewing the report, the committee accepted the recommendations.
After reviewing report, the committee accepted the recommendations.
questions.e: Recommendations did not review anything. The doer must follow the comma.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The country has rarely been so divided. (Inversion.)”?
o: Rarely has not the country been so divided.
The country has rarely been so divided. (Inversion.)
Rarely has the country been so divided.
Rarely have the country been so divided.
questions.e: Rarely has the country been so divided. (Inversion Day 23.)

questions.q: Which Part of Speech is associated with Examples “at (Time - 6 p.m.)on (Place - Table)to (Direction - Shop)” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 229: Part of Speech “Preposition” corresponds to Examples “at (Time - 6 p.m.)on (Place - Table)to (Direction - Shop)”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “There is many objections to the draft law.”?
o: There are many objections to the draft law.
There is many objections to the draft law.
There are not many objections to the draft law.
There are many objections to the draft law without.
questions.e: In a there-sentence the verb agrees with the noun after it — objections.

questions.q: Which Preposition is associated with Rule “Desire/longing related to personality” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 233: Preposition “Of / For / To” corresponds to Rule “Desire/longing related to personality”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “There’s tons of corruption and nobody’s doing anything.”?
o: Corruption are widespread, and little is being done to address it.
Corruption is not widespread, and little is being done to address it.
There’s tons of corruption and nobody’s doing anything.
Corruption is widespread, and little is being done to address it.
questions.e: Corruption is widespread, and little is being done to address it. (Slang removed, measured tone.)

questions.q: Which Direct Speech is associated with Example “He said, "I am busy now." → He said that he was busy then.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 227: Direct Speech “Now” corresponds to Example “He said, "I am busy now." → He said that he was busy then.”.

questions.q: Which Indirect Speech is associated with Direct Speech “He said, "The sun rises in the east."” in the English reference?
o: He said that the sun rises in the east.
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 226: Indirect Speech “He said that the sun rises in the east.” corresponds to Direct Speech “He said, "The sun rises in the east."”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Between you and I, the committee has already made their decision.”?
o: Between you and me, the committee have already made its decision.
Between you and me, the committee has already made its decision.
Between you and I, the committee has already made their decision.
Between you and me, the committee has not already made its decision.
questions.e: Object form after between; a collective noun takes its.

questions.q: Which Direct Speech is associated with Indirect Speech “Should” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 227: Direct Speech “Shall” corresponds to Indirect Speech “Should”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Example Word “beautiful” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Descriptive Adjective” corresponds to Example Word “beautiful”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Everyone who appeared in the test must collect their result card himself.”?
o: Everyone who appeared in the test must collect their result card himself.
Everyone who appeared in the test must collect their result card in person.
Everyone who appeared in test must collect their result card in person.
Everyone who appeared in the test must not collect their result card in person.
questions.e: Do not mix they and he for one antecedent; in person replaces the misused reflexive.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Definition “Expresses emotions” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 231: Type “Emotive Interjection” corresponds to Definition “Expresses emotions”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The minister’s speech was, like, totally unconvincing.”?
o: The minister’s speech were wholly unconvincing.
The minister’s speech was not wholly unconvincing.
The minister’s speech was, like, totally unconvincing.
The minister’s speech was wholly unconvincing.
questions.e: The minister’s speech was wholly unconvincing. (Filler and slang removed.)

questions.q: Which Preposition is associated with Rule “Used for working position” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 231: Preposition “At” corresponds to Rule “Used for working position”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “To improving literacy, the government built new schools.”?
o: To improve literacy, the government built new schools.
To improving literacy, the government built new schools.
To improve literacy, the government built new schools not.
than improve literacy, the government built new schools.
questions.e: To improve literacy, the government built new schools. (Infinitive of purpose, not to + -ing.)

questions.q: Which version is best for an examination answer?
o: Honestly speaking, the reforms were a total failure.
The reforms, you can see, were useless.
The reforms failed to achieve their stated objectives.
I think the reforms didn’t work out.
questions.e: Impersonal, specific and formal.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Example (Passive) “You are advised to follow the rules.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 224: Type “Advice (Kindly)” corresponds to Example (Passive) “You are advised to follow the rules.”.

questions.q: Which Preposition is associated with Rule “Travel using private vehicles” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 233: Preposition “In” corresponds to Rule “Travel using private vehicles”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Myself and the deputy director has prepared the summary for the minister.”?
o: Myself and the deputy director has prepared the summary for the minister.
The deputy director and I have prepared the summary for the minister.
The deputy director and I has prepared the summary for the minister.
The deputy director and I have not prepared the summary for the minister.
questions.e: A reflexive cannot be a subject, and a joined plural subject takes have.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The policy was a complete and utter disaster, to be honest.”?
o: The policy were a serious failure.
The policy was not a serious failure.
The policy was a complete and utter disaster, to be honest.
The policy was a serious failure.
questions.e: The policy was a serious failure. (Emotion measured; no to be honest.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Statistics on poverty shows a worrying trend.”?
o: Statistics on poverty show an worrying trend.
Statistics on poverty show a worrying trend not.
Statistics on poverty shows a worrying trend.
Statistics on poverty show a worrying trend.
questions.e: Statistics on poverty show a worrying trend. (Here statistics = figures, plural. As a field of study it would be singular.)

questions.s: Modifiers: put the describing words where they belong
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Being a public holiday, the office was closed and we could not submit the form.”?
o: Being a public holiday, the office was closed and we could not submit the form.
Because it was a public holiday, the office was closed and we could not submit the form.
Because it were a public holiday, the office was closed and we could not submit the form.
Because it was not a public holiday, the office was closed and we could not submit the form.
questions.e: The office is not a public holiday. Turning the phrase into a full clause supplies the missing subject.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “We need to find out what went wrong and get rid of the bad actors.”?
o: We need to find out what went wrong and get rid of the bad actors.
We must not ascertain what went wrong and remove those responsible.
We must ascertain what went wrong and remove those responsible without.
We must ascertain what went wrong and remove those responsible.
questions.e: We must ascertain what went wrong and remove those responsible. (Phrasal verbs upgraded.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Economics are central to the civil service examination.”?
o: Economics are central to the civil service examination.
Economics is not central to the civil service examination.
Economics is central to the civil service examination without.
Economics is central to the civil service examination.
questions.e: Economics is central to the civil service examination. (Economics as a discipline is singular.)

questions.q: Which Tense is associated with Structure “subject + will/shall have been + verb-ing” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 244: Tense “Future Perfect Continuous” corresponds to Structure “subject + will/shall have been + verb-ing”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “I will revise grammar thoroughly before the examination.”?
o: I will not spend fifteen minutes each morning on the daily routine, and redo the Day 29 simulation on the first of every month.
I will revise grammar thoroughly before the examination.
I will spend fifteen minutes each morning on the daily routine, and redo the Day 29 simulation on the first of every month.
I will spend fifteen minutes each morning on daily routine, and redo the Day 29 simulation on the first of every month.
questions.e: A plan with a time, a task and a date is a plan. Everything else is an intention.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The aforementioned utilisation of resources was suboptimal in nature.”?
o: The use of resources were inadequate.
The use of resources was not inadequate.
The aforementioned utilisation of resources was suboptimal in nature.
The use of resources was inadequate.
questions.e: The use of resources was inadequate. (Inflation stripped out.)

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Example “He said, "Work hard." → He advised to work hard.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 228: Type “Advice” corresponds to Example “He said, "Work hard." → He advised to work hard.”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Neither the judges nor the lawyer were satisfied.”?
o: Neither the judges nor the lawyer was satisfied without.
Neither the judges nor the lawyer was not satisfied.
Neither the judges nor the lawyer were satisfied.
Neither the judges nor the lawyer was satisfied.
questions.e: Neither the judges nor the lawyer was satisfied. (Verb agrees with the nearer subject, lawyer.)

questions.s: Modifiers: put the describing words where they belong
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “While travelling to Peshawar, the luggage of the delegation was stolen.”?
o: While travelling to Peshawar, the luggage of the delegation was stolen.
While the delegation was travelling to Peshawar, its luggage was stolen.
While the delegation were travelling to Peshawar, its luggage was stolen.
While the delegation was not travelling to Peshawar, its luggage was stolen.
questions.e: The luggage was not travelling on its own; make the opening a full clause.

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Preposition “Through” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 232: Rule “To finish or overcome something” corresponds to Preposition “Through”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Sentence Example “He gave up smoking.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Phrasal Verb” corresponds to Sentence Example “He gave up smoking.”.

questions.q: The measure was ____ rather than political: it saved money.
questions.e: Economical means thrifty; economic relates to the economy.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The number of pending cases are alarming.”?
o: The number of pending cases are alarming.
The number of pending cases is not alarming.
The number of pending cases is alarming without.
The number of pending cases is alarming.
questions.e: The number of pending cases is alarming. (The number is singular.)

questions.q: Which Preposition is associated with Rule “Applied to a person or institution” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 232: Preposition “To” corresponds to Rule “Applied to a person or institution”.

questions.s: Modifiers: put the describing words where they belong
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The candidate only answered three questions in the whole paper.”?
o: The candidate only answered three questions in the whole paper.
The candidate answered only three questions in the whole paper not.
candidate answered only three questions in the whole paper.
The candidate answered only three questions in the whole paper.
questions.e: Only limits the number of questions, so it must stand beside three.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Memorising a list of two hundred collocations.”?
o: Collecting ten collocations a day from real reading, in whole phrases not.

questions.q: The first term in a sequence is 1 and the second term is 5. From the third term onwards, each term is the average (arithmetic mean) of all preceding terms. What is the 27th term in the sequence?

questions.q: The lights and brakes of 30 bicycles were tested. 27 bicycles passed the lights and 21 passed the brakes test. The lights and brakes both failed on one bicycle. How many bicycles passed both tests?

questions.q: The forest workers plant 200 trees in one month (30 days). When 20 workers were sent away, 200 trees were planted in 40 days by this second group. How many workers were there in the first group?
questions.e: Equal work at equal individual rates requires 30N=40(N−20) worker-days. Thus N=80 initially.

questions.e: ہاتھ ملنا گزرے موقع پر پچھتانے کے معنی میں ہے۔

questions.e: اختتام کسی عمل کے انجام کو کہتے ہیں۔

o: اپنی جگہ یا مؤقف سے بالکل نہ ہٹنا
questions.e: یہ محاورہ مکمل ثابت قدمی یا بے حرکتی ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

questions.q: «نجی» کا متضاد کون سا ہے؟
questions.e: نجی کے مقابل سرکاری استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

Move heaven and earth کا درست ترجمہ کیا ہے؟

اسمِ مشتق — جو کسی اور لفظ (خاص طور پر مصدر) سے بنا ہو

questions.q: ان اصطلاحات—اسمِ فاعل، اسمِ مفعول، اسمِ جمع، اسمِ معاوضہ—میں درست اصطلاح اور تعریف کا جوڑا منتخب کریں۔
o: اسمِ معاوضہ — جو کسی کام کا نشانہ بننے والے پر دلالت کرے
اسمِ جمع — جو کسی معاوضے، اجرت یا مزدوری کے لیے استعمال ہو
اسمِ مفعول — جو کسی گروہ یا مجموعے پر دلالت کرے
اسمِ فاعل — جو کسی کام کو کرنے والے پر دلالت کرے (مصدر سے بنا ہو)

questions.q: ان اصطلاحات—مرک بِ اشارہ، مرک بِ تمیز و ممیز، مرک بِ تابع و متبوع (مہمل)، مرک بِ تابع و متبوع (موضوع)—میں درست اصطلاح اور تعریف کا جوڑا منتخب کریں۔
o: مرک بِ تابع و متبوع (موضوع) — تمیز وہ اسم جو شک دور کرے، اور ممیز وہ ہے جس کے لیے شک دور کیا جائے۔
مرک بِ تابع و متبوع (مہمل) — دو بامعنی الفاظ پر مشتمل، جہاں ایک دوسرے کی پیروی کرتا ہو۔
مرک بِ تمیز و ممیز — ایک بے معنی لفظ اور ایک بامعنی لفظ پر مشتمل۔
مرک بِ اشارہ — اسم اور اسمِ اشارہ پر مشتمل ترکیب۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 214: مرک بِ اشارہ — اسم اور اسمِ اشارہ پر مشتمل ترکیب۔

questions.q: یہ تعریف کس اصطلاح کی ہے؟ “جو فاعل یا مفعول کی حالت یا کیفیت کو ظاہر کرے”
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 209: اسمِ حالیہّ — جو فاعل یا مفعول کی حالت یا کیفیت کو ظاہر کرے

questions.q: تعریف “وہ فعل جو اپنے اثر کو کسی اور (مفعول) تک پہنچائے۔” اور مثال “احمد نے کتاب پڑھی” کس اصطلاح کو ظاہر کرتی ہیں؟
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 210: متعدی — وہ فعل جو اپنے اثر کو کسی اور (مفعول) تک پہنچائے۔

questions.q: “موقوف و ساکن” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: وقف کی صورت میں لفظ کا آخری حرف ساکن ہو جاتا ہے۔
دو ہم آواز حروف کو مال کر ایک ساتھ پڑھنا یا لکھنا۔
امال کے لحاظ سے کسی لفظ میں الف یا ی کو بڑی ے میں تبدیل کرنا۔
حرکت کو لمبا کر کے پڑھنا
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 213: موقوف و ساکن — وقف کی صورت میں لفظ کا آخری حرف ساکن ہو جاتا ہے۔

questions.q: تعریف “ایسے الفاظ کا مجموعہ جو مکمل مفہوم دے۔” اور مثال “علی اسکول گیا۔” کس اصطلاح کو ظاہر کرتی ہیں؟
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 215: جملے کی تعریف — ایسے الفاظ کا مجموعہ جو مکمل مفہوم دے۔

questions.q: تعریف “مشابہت یا مثال دے” اور مثال “بارش کے موتی، چاند کا چہرہ” کس اصطلاح کو ظاہر کرتی ہیں؟

questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 212: حرفِ ندا — جو کسی کو پکارنے کے لیے استعمال ہو۔

questions.q:
Read the passage: “An irrigation project reduced the amount of water used per field. Farmers then planted a larger area, so the district’s total water use barely changed. The project team decided to report both water saved per field and total water withdrawn.”

Why are both figures needed?
o: Efficiency per field and total consumption tell different stories
The area under crops never changes
Total withdrawals are impossible to count
Saving water per field always reduces district use
questions.e: Expansion can offset savings achieved on each field.

questions.q:
Read the passage: “An irrigation project reduced the amount of water used per field. Farmers then planted a larger area, so the district’s total water use barely changed. The project team decided to report both water saved per field and total water withdrawn.”

Which inference is best supported?
o: Efficiency alone need not lower aggregate demand
questions.e: The district total stayed similar despite per-field savings.

questions.q: Zachary was doomed to a miserable life, for no matter how much he had, he always _____ the possessions of others.
questions.e: To “covet” another person’s possessions is to desire them intensely.

questions.q: Antonym of Quixotic:
questions.e: “Quixotic” describes impractical idealism; “practical” is the opposite quality.

questions.q: Identify the antonym of Equanimity.
questions.e: “Equanimity” is calmness under pressure; “agitation” is a disturbed state.

questions.q: _____ woman that we saw turned out to be our CEO.
questions.e: “The woman that we saw” identifies one particular woman, requiring the definite article.

questions.q: "Although they are 250 miles apart, they keep in constant contact on the internet." This is a:
questions.e: The dependent although-clause joins an independent clause; this makes a complex sentence.

questions.q: Which Indirect Speech is associated with Direct Speech “These” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 227: Indirect Speech “Those” corresponds to Direct Speech “These”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Sentence Example “Who called you?” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Interrogative Pronoun” corresponds to Sentence Example “Who called you?”.

questions.q: The Indus is longer than ____ river in South Asia.
questions.e: The Indus is a South Asian river, so it must be excluded from the group.

questions.q: Which Tense is associated with Example (Active) “He will finish the work.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 224: Tense “Future Indefinite” corresponds to Example (Active) “He will finish the work.”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Taxes were raised ___ the deficit widened anyway.”?
o: Taxes were not raised; nonetheless, the deficit widened anyway.
Taxes were raised ___ the deficit widened anyway.
Taxes were raised; nonetheless, the deficit widened anyway.
Taxes was raised; nonetheless, the deficit widened anyway.
questions.e: Taxes were raised; nonetheless, the deficit widened anyway. (contrast.)

questions.q: Which Part of Speech is associated with Definition “Modifies verb, adjective, or sentence” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 229: Part of Speech “Adverb” corresponds to Definition “Modifies verb, adjective, or sentence”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “He asked me that where had I kept the file?”?
o: He asked me where I had kept the file.
He asked me where I had kept file.
He asked me where I had not kept the file.
He asked me that where had I kept the file?
questions.e: Delete that, restore statement order, remove the question mark.

questions.s: Future forms and the sequence of tenses
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “By the end of this year the government will implement all the reforms.”?
o: By the end of this year the government will implement all the reforms.
By the end of this year the government will not have implemented all the reforms.
By the end of this year the government will has implemented all the reforms.
By the end of this year the government will have implemented all the reforms.
questions.e: By + future point marks completion, so the future perfect is needed.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The economy grew ___ the benefits never reached the poor.”?
o: The economy grew; nevertheless, the benefits never reached the poor not.
economy grew; nevertheless, the benefits never reached the poor.
The economy grew; nevertheless, the benefits never reached the poor.
The economy grew ___ the benefits never reached the poor.
questions.e: The economy grew; nevertheless, the benefits never reached the poor. (contrast/concession.)

questions.q: Which Connector Type is associated with Explanation / Usage “Introduce a dependent clause in complex sentences” in the English reference?
o: Noun Clause Introducers (That, What, Whether, If, etc.)
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 234: Connector Type “Subordinating Conjunctions (Adverb Clause)” corresponds to Explanation / Usage “Introduce a dependent clause in complex sentences”.

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Example Sentence “He is the Shakespeare of our times.” in the English reference?
o: With proper nouns used in a descriptive sense
Before a certain or specific unidentified thing
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 225: Rule “With proper nouns used in a descriptive sense” corresponds to Example Sentence “He is the Shakespeare of our times.”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Passive Formula “You are advised to + V1 + Object” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 224: Type “Advice (Kindly)” corresponds to Passive Formula “You are advised to + V1 + Object”.

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Examples (with Prepositions Highlighted) “He disagreed with his manager.” in the English reference?
o: Applied to a person or institution
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 232: Rule “Disagreement with a person” corresponds to Examples (with Prepositions Highlighted) “He disagreed with his manager.”.

questions.s: Modifiers: put the describing words where they belong
questions.q: Which adjective order is natural?
questions.e: Size precedes age, which precedes material.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The reforms were announced with fanfare ___ they were quietly abandoned.”?
o: ...with fanfare; however, they were not quietly abandoned.
The reforms were announced with fanfare ___ they were quietly abandoned.
...with fanfare; however, they were quietly abandoned.
...with fanfare; however, they was quietly abandoned.
questions.e: ...with fanfare; however, they were quietly abandoned. (contrast.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Remove redundancy: The final end result was a completely unanimous consensus.”?
o: The result were a unanimous consensus. Better still where context allows: The decision was unanimous.
The result was not a unanimous consensus. Better still where context allows: The decision was unanimous.
Remove redundancy: The final end result was a completely unanimous consensus.
The result was a unanimous consensus. Better still where context allows: The decision was unanimous.
questions.e: The result was a unanimous consensus. Better still where context allows: The decision was unanimous. (Redundancy removed.)

questions.s: Modifiers: put the describing words where they belong
questions.q: Which sentence is unambiguous?
o: Students who study regularly often succeed.
Students who study succeed often regularly.
questions.e: In option B, often squints between study and succeed.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “She said me that she is preparing for the examination since January.”?
o: She told me that she had been preparing for the examination since January.
She told me she had been preparing for the examination since January.
She told me that she had not been preparing for the examination since January.
She said me that she is preparing for the examination since January.
questions.e: Say does not take a person; the present perfect continuous backshifts to the past perfect continuous.

questions.q: Which Tense is associated with Example “She will be writing at noon.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 244: Tense “Future Continuous” corresponds to Example “She will be writing at noon.”.

questions.s: Modifiers: put the describing words where they belong
questions.q: The minister ____ been criticised for the appointment.
questions.e: A frequency adverb follows the first auxiliary: has repeatedly been criticised.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The officer told that all applications will be scrutinised tomorrow.”?
o: The officer said that all applications would be scrutinised the next day.
The officer told that all applications will be scrutinised tomorrow.
The officer said that all applications would not be scrutinised the next day.
officer said that all applications would be scrutinised the next day.
questions.e: Tell needs a person, will backshifts to would, and tomorrow becomes the next day.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The plan was underfunded ___ poorly designed ___ doomed. (addition then result)”?
o: The plan was not underfunded and poorly designed; as a result, it was doomed.
The plan was underfunded ___ poorly designed ___ doomed. (addition then result)
The plan was underfunded and poorly designed; as a result, it was doomed.
The plan were underfunded and poorly designed; as a result, it was doomed.
questions.e: The plan was underfunded and poorly designed; as a result, it was doomed. (addition then result.)

questions.q: Which Direct Speech is associated with Example “He said, "I will go today." → He said that he would go that day.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 227: Direct Speech “Today” corresponds to Example “He said, "I will go today." → He said that he would go that day.”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Example Word “at, in” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Preposition of Time” corresponds to Example Word “at, in”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “He is one of the most hardly working officers in the department.”?
o: He is one of the most hardly working officers in the department.
He is one of the hardest-working officers in the department.
He are one of the hardest-working officers in the department.
He is not one of the hardest-working officers in the department.
questions.e: Hardly means “almost not”. The adverb of effort is hard.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Corruption persists ___ the laws against it are strong. (contrast)”?
o: Corruption persists even though the laws against it are not strong.
Corruption persists even though the laws against it is strong.
Corruption persists even though the laws against it are strong.
Corruption persists ___ the laws against it are strong. (contrast)
questions.e: Corruption persists even though the laws against it are strong. (contrast/concession.)

questions.q: Which Tense is associated with Passive Formula “Object + is/am/are + V3 + by + Subject” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 224: Tense “Present Indefinite” corresponds to Passive Formula “Object + is/am/are + V3 + by + Subject”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Example “He said, "Please help me." → He requested to help him.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 228: Type “Request” corresponds to Example “He said, "Please help me." → He requested to help him.”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The teacher ordered the class that they should not make noise.”?
o: The teacher ordered the class not to make any noise.
The teacher ordered the class that they should not make noise.
The teacher ordered the class not to make any noise not.
The teacher ordered the class not than make any noise.
questions.e: A command is reported with to + infinitive, not a that-clause.

questions.q: Which Preposition is associated with Rule “Travel using public/shared transport” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 233: Preposition “On” corresponds to Rule “Travel using public/shared transport”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Exhausted by the campaign, the rally was cancelled by the leader.”?
o: Exhausted by the campaign, the rally was cancelled by the leader.
Exhausted by the campaign, the leader cancelled the rally.
Exhausted by campaign, the leader cancelled the rally.
Exhausted by the campaign, the leader cancelled the rally not.
questions.e: Exhausted by the campaign, the leader cancelled the rally. (The leader was exhausted, not the rally.)

questions.q: Which Preposition is associated with Rule “General residence/location” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 232: Preposition “In” corresponds to Rule “General residence/location”.

questions.s: Future forms and the sequence of tenses
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Unless the funds will be released, the contractor will stop the work.”?
o: Unless the funds will be released, the contractor will stop the work.
Unless the funds are not released, the contractor will stop the work.
Unless the funds is released, the contractor will stop the work.
Unless the funds are released, the contractor will stop the work.
questions.e: Unless introduces a condition clause and takes a present tense.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “She suggested to increase the education budget.”?
o: She suggested increasing the education budget.
She suggested to increase the education budget.
She suggested increasing the education budget not.
questions.e: She suggested increasing the education budget. (Suggest + gerund.)

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Sentence Example “He is my friend.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Personal Pronoun” corresponds to Sentence Example “He is my friend.”.

questions.q: Which Preposition is associated with Rule “Used when some work is finished, or for disconnection/cutting” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 231: Preposition “Off” corresponds to Rule “Used when some work is finished, or for disconnection/cutting”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Sentence Example “He always arrives late.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Adverb of Frequency” corresponds to Sentence Example “He always arrives late.”.

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Example Sentence “He is the best player on the team.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 225: Rule “With superlatives” corresponds to Example Sentence “He is the best player on the team.”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Reporting Verb “Proposed” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 228: Type “Proposal” corresponds to Reporting Verb “Proposed”.

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Examples (with Prepositions Highlighted) “He applied for a job in the bank.” in the English reference?
o: Applied for a thing or purpose
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 232: Rule “Applied for a thing or purpose” corresponds to Examples (with Prepositions Highlighted) “He applied for a job in the bank.”.

questions.q: Which Tense is associated with Structure “subject + will/shall have + past participle” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 244: Tense “Future Perfect” corresponds to Structure “subject + will/shall have + past participle”.

questions.s: Present and past: the four forms of each
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Did the committee submitted its findings before the deadline?”?
o: Did the committee submitted its findings before the deadline?
Did the committee submit its findings before the deadline?
Did committee submit its findings before the deadline?
Did the committee submit its findings before the deadline not.?
questions.e: Did carries the past tense; the main verb reverts to the base form.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The medicine had no (affect / effect) on the patient.”?
o: The medicine had no (affect / effect) on the patient.
questions.e: ...no effect on the patient. (effect = noun, result.)

questions.q: A student spends 15% of his scholarship grant on food and 45% on tuition. After spending 50% of the remaining grant on his hostel fee, he is left with Rs 8,000 only. How much is his scholarship grant?
questions.e: After food and tuition, 40% remains. Half of that remains after the hostel fee, so Rs 8,000 is 20% of the grant. The grant was Rs 40,000.

questions.q: At a football match, the price of child ticket is Rs. 240 less than the adult ticket. There are 18,500 adults and 2500 children attending the match. Total amount paid for tickets is Rs. 41,400,000. What is the price of an adult ticket?
questions.e: If the adult ticket costs p, the child ticket costs p−240. Then 18,500p+2,500(p−240)=41,400,000, giving p=Rs 2,000.

questions.q: A baker sells different types of cakes in his shop. Every small cake costs $x and every large cake costs $(2x + 3). The cost of 3 small lemon cakes and 2 large lemon cakes is $16.36. What is the cost of one small lemon cake?
questions.e: With a small cake costing x, 3x+2(2x+3)=16.36, so 7x=10.36 and x=$1.48.

questions.q: Several number of cows on a farm consume the food in 150 days. If we reduce the number of cows by 10, then the food lasts for 160 days. How many cows were there on the farm in the beginning?
questions.e: If N cows consume a fixed store in 150 days, then 150N=160(N−10). Solving gives N=160.

questions.q: A jug contains 2 litres of a mixture of apple juice and orange juice in the ratio 3:5. We take out 400 ml of juice from the jug. How much more apple juice needs to be added so that the ratio becomes 7:5?
questions.e: Initially there are 750 ml apple and 1,250 ml orange. After removing 400 ml uniformly, 600 ml apple and 1,000 ml orange remain. (600+x)/1,000=7/5 gives x=800 ml.

questions.q: A water tank in the shape of a cuboid has length 1.5 metres and width 1.0 metre. How many litres of water are in the tank if the water is 60 centimetres deep?
questions.e: The water volume is 1.5×1.0×0.60=0.9 m³. As 1 m³ is 1,000 litres, the tank holds 900 litres at that depth.

questions.q: Survey-unit review — The mean of 12 observations in a report is 66. One entry, 56, is corrected to 80. What is the corrected mean?
questions.e: The total rises by 24; divided across 12 observations, the mean rises by 2 to 68.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — The mean of 20 observations in a report is 65. One entry, 55, is corrected to 95. What is the corrected mean?
questions.e: The total rises by 40; divided across 20 observations, the mean rises by 2 to 67.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — Two batches assessed by a warehouse contain 71 and 16 candidates with mean scores 57 and 82. What is the combined mean?
questions.e: Use the weighted mean: (71 × 57 + 16 × 82) ÷ 87 = 61.6.

questions.q: District-office worksheet — The roots of x² − 124x + 3840 = 0 differ by 4. What is the larger root?
questions.e: The quadratic factors as (x − 60)(x − 64); the larger root is 64.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — The roots of x² − 27x + 176 = 0 differ by 5. What is the larger root?
questions.e: The quadratic factors as (x − 11)(x − 16); the larger root is 16.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — A bag holds 13 red and 7 blue counters. Two are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
questions.e: Multiply the changing probabilities: 13/20 × 12/19 = 41.05%.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — A bag holds 14 red and 8 blue counters. Two are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
questions.e: Multiply the changing probabilities: 14/22 × 13/21 = 39.39%.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — Two batches assessed by a relief camp contain 76 and 12 candidates with mean scores 51 and 74. What is the combined mean?
questions.e: Use the weighted mean: (76 × 51 + 12 × 74) ÷ 88 = 54.14.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — After a 10% discount and then 5% sales tax, an equipment bill for a relief camp is Rs 32130. What was the listed price?

questions.e: قبول کے مقابل رد آتا ہے۔

questions.q: محاورہ «آنکھ کا تارا» کا مطلب کیا ہے؟
questions.e: آنکھ کا تارا انتہائی عزیز شخص کو کہتے ہیں۔

questions.q: «تاخیر» کا متضاد مفہوم کون سا ہے؟
questions.e: تاخیر دیر کو اور بروقت انجام مقررہ وقت پر تکمیل کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

questions.q: محاورہ «ہاتھ پاؤں پھول جانا» کس کیفیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے؟
questions.e: گھبراہٹ میں آدمی کا حواس کھو بیٹھنا اس محاورے کا مفہوم ہے۔

questions.q: "Minutes of the Meeting" کا درست اردو متبادل کیا ہے؟
وہم کی جمع کیا ہے؟
یہ تعریف کس اصطلاح کی ہے؟ “ایک ہی لفظ پر مشتمل فعل۔”
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 210: فعل مفرد — ایک ہی لفظ پر مشتمل فعل۔

questions.q: “بیانی” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: ایک لفظ دوسرے کا مادہ ہو (جس سے وہ بنا ہو)
وہ علم جس میں الفاظ کے باہمی تعلق اور ترکیب سے جملے بننے کے قواعد بیان کیے جاتے ہیں۔
مجازی مفہوم دے (کسی کو کسی اور سے تعبیر کرنا)
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 214: بیانی — ایک لفظ دوسرے کا مادہ ہو (جس سے وہ بنا ہو)

questions.q: “حرو فِ شمسیة” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: کل: 51 ایسے حروف جن کے ساتھ "ال" لگانے پر "ل" واضح پڑھی جاتی ہے
کل: 51 ایسے حروف جن کے ساتھ "ال" لگانے پر "ل" کا تلفظ نہیں ہوتا
اوپر کی چھوٹی لکیر جو آواز کو کھولتی ہے۔
متحرک: جس حرف پر حرکت (زبر، زیر، پیش) ہو۔ساکن: جس پر کوئی حرکت نہ ہو بلکہ جزم ہو۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 213: حرو فِ شمسیة — کل: 51 ایسے حروف جن کے ساتھ "ال" لگانے پر "ل" کا تلفظ نہیں ہوتا

questions.q: یہ تعریف کس اصطلاح کی ہے؟ “خبر + )جس کے بارے میں بات ہو(مبتدا )جو بات کی جائے(”
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 215: جملے کے عناصر — خبر + )جس کے بارے میں بات ہو(مبتدا )جو بات کی جائے(

questions.q: ان اصطلاحات—اسمِ اشارہ، اسمِ موصول، خطاب، لقب—میں درست اصطلاح اور تعریف کا جوڑا منتخب کریں۔
o: اسمِ موصول — وہ اسم جو کسی شخص کو عزت یا احترام سے پکارنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔
خطاب — وہ اسم جو کسی شخص کو کسی خاص خصوصیت یا حیثیت کی وجہ سے دیا جاتا ہے۔
لقب — وہ اسم جو کسی جملے یا فقرے کے ساتھ منسلک ہوتا ہو اور مکمل معنی تب تک نہیں دیتا جب تک کہ دوسرا جملہ اس کے ساتھ نہ ہو۔
اسمِ اشارہ — وہ اسم جو کسی چیز یا شخص کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہو۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 209: اسمِ اشارہ — وہ اسم جو کسی چیز یا شخص کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہو۔

questions.q: تعریف “وہ حروف جن کا تلفظ صاف، واضح اور مکمل ہوتا ہے” اور مثال “ب، ج، د، س، ف، ک، ل، م (Called Consonants in English)” کس اصطلاح کو ظاہر کرتی ہیں؟
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 212: حرو فِ صحیح — وہ حروف جن کا تلفظ صاف، واضح اور مکمل ہوتا ہے

questions.q: یہ تعریف کس اصطلاح کی ہے؟ “ایسا لفظ جس کا با معنی ہونا ضروری ہو اور وہ جملے میں استعمال ہو سکے۔”
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 208: کلمہ — ایسا لفظ جس کا با معنی ہونا ضروری ہو اور وہ جملے میں استعمال ہو سکے۔

o: بڑے جزو — 1. مرکب .2 )ایک ہی خیال(مفرد جملہ )دو یا زیادہ خیاالت جُڑے ہوں(جملہ
ترکیب کے لحاظ سے اقسام — 1. ایک جملہ دوسرے پر (مرکب مطلق ایک جملہ (مرکب ملتف .2 )منحصر نہ ہو )دوسرے پر منحصر ہو

questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 208: اسمِ مفعول — جو کسی کام کا نشانہ بننے والے پر دلالت کرے

questions.q:
Read the passage: “A school reported higher examination scores after adding evening classes. During the same year, many experienced teachers returned from leave. The head teacher praised the results but said the classes could not yet be credited with the entire improvement.”

What comparison would be most useful?
o: Comparable pupils with and without the classes
The colour of the classroom walls
Only the highest score in each class
The number of holidays in another country
questions.e: Comparable groups could help isolate the classes’ effect.

questions.q:
Read the passage: “A school reported higher examination scores after adding evening classes. During the same year, many experienced teachers returned from leave. The head teacher praised the results but said the classes could not yet be credited with the entire improvement.”

What is the head teacher’s main reservation?
o: There may be another cause of the higher scores
Evening classes did not take place
questions.e: Returning experienced teachers are an alternative explanation.

questions.q: He writes _____ red ink.
questions.e: The idiomatic expression for the medium is “write in red ink”.

questions.q: I know both of them are short _____ money because of their extravagant nature.
questions.e: The fixed adjective phrase is “short of money”.

questions.q: Ambition does not always conduce _____ ultimate happiness.
questions.e: “Conduce to” means to contribute to a particular outcome; here the outcome is ultimate happiness.

questions.q: He accepted the car in lieu _____ his claim _____ Rs. 4,55,000.
questions.e: The fixed expression is “in lieu of”; a claim is for a specified amount.

questions.q: Send this letter _____ my address.
questions.e: A letter sent to an address takes the preposition “to”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “She asked whether had the report been finalised.”?
o: She asked whether the report had been finalised.
She asked whether report had been finalised.
She asked whether the report had not been finalised.
She asked whether had the report been finalised.
questions.e: She asked whether the report had been finalised. (Reported question statement word order.)

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Example Sentence “Gold is a precious metal. Iron is used in construction.” in the English reference?
o: No article before titles (when used with names)
No article before abstract nouns (general idea)
No article before cities and countries (general rule)
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 225: Rule “No article before metals” corresponds to Example Sentence “Gold is a precious metal. Iron is used in construction.”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Corruption is widespread, it erodes public confidence.”?
o: Corruption is widespread, and it erodes public confidence.
Corruption is widespread, it erodes public confidence.
Corruption is not widespread, and it erodes public confidence.
Corruption are widespread, and it erodes public confidence.
questions.e: Corruption is widespread, and it erodes public confidence. (Comma splice fixed.)

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Definition “Verb + preposition” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Phrasal Verb” corresponds to Definition “Verb + preposition”.

questions.q: Which Indirect Speech is associated with Direct Speech “Here” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 227: Indirect Speech “There” corresponds to Direct Speech “Here”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Sentence Example “She is very tired.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Adverb of Degree” corresponds to Sentence Example “She is very tired.”.

questions.q: Which Tense is associated with Structure “subject + past form” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 244: Tense “Past Simple” corresponds to Structure “subject + past form”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “He advice me to practice grammar daily and to analyze my mistakes seperately.”?
o: He advised me than practise grammar daily and to analyse my mistakes separately.
He advised me to practise grammar daily and to analyse my mistakes separately not.
He advice me to practice grammar daily and to analyze my mistakes seperately.
He advised me to practise grammar daily and to analyse my mistakes separately.
questions.e: Verb forms advise and practise, British spelling analyse, and the correct spelling of separately.

questions.s: Modifiers: put the describing words where they belong
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “We interviewed the officer in the corridor who had signed the order.”?
o: We interviewed the officer who had signed the order in the corridor.
We interviewed officer who had signed the order in the corridor.
We interviewed the officer who had not signed the order in the corridor.
We interviewed the officer in the corridor who had signed the order.
questions.e: Better still: “In the corridor, we interviewed the officer who had signed the order,” if the corridor is where the interview happened.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Sentence Example “I have finished.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Auxiliary Verb” corresponds to Sentence Example “I have finished.”.

questions.q: Which Preposition is associated with Rule “Fitness or usefulness” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 232: Preposition “To” corresponds to Rule “Fitness or usefulness”.

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Preposition “In / On” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 233: Rule “Confusion over "sat in/on" tree” corresponds to Preposition “In / On”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “If the government would reduce tariffs, exports will rise.”?
o: If the government reduced tariffs, exports would rise.
If government reduced tariffs, exports would rise.
If the government reduced tariffs, exports would not rise.
If the government would reduce tariffs, exports will rise.
questions.e: If the government reduced tariffs, exports would rise. (Second conditional hypothetical.) Or, if likely: If the government reduces tariffs, exports will rise.

questions.q: Which Part of Speech is associated with Examples “this (Demonstrative)my (Possessive)many (Quantifier)” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 229: Part of Speech “Determiners” corresponds to Examples “this (Demonstrative)my (Possessive)many (Quantifier)”.

questions.q: Which Part of Speech is associated with Definition “Shows relationship between words” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 229: Part of Speech “Preposition” corresponds to Definition “Shows relationship between words”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The policy aims to reduce (continuous / continual) interruptions to supply.”?
o: The policy aims to reduce (continuous / continual) interruptions to supply.
questions.e: ...reduce continual interruptions to supply. (continual = repeated, on and off.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “We must (ensure / insure) that every vote is counted.”?
o: We must (ensure / insure) that every vote is counted.
We must ensure that every vote is counted.
We must ensure that every vote are counted.
We must not ensure that every vote is counted.
questions.e: We must ensure that every vote is counted. (ensure = make certain.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “He is an university student who wants to do MA.”?
o: He is a university student who wants to do an MA.
He are a university student who wants to do an MA.
He is not a university student who wants to do an MA.
He is an university student who wants to do MA.
questions.e: University begins with the consonant sound y; MA begins with the vowel sound e.

questions.q: Which sentence uses the subjunctive correctly?
o: The court ordered that the record be produced.
The court ordered that the record is produced.
The court ordered that the record producing.
The court ordered that the record produces.
questions.e: After order, demand or recommend, a that-clause takes the bare form.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The traffic was (stationary / stationery) for an hour.”?
o: The traffic were stationary for an hour.
The traffic was stationary for an hour.
The traffic was (stationary / stationery) for an hour.
The traffic was not stationary for an hour.
questions.e: The traffic was stationary for an hour. (stationary = not moving.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Hardly he had arrived when the crisis erupted.”?
o: Hardly had he arrived when crisis erupted.
Hardly had not he arrived when the crisis erupted.
Hardly he had arrived when the crisis erupted.
Hardly had he arrived when the crisis erupted.
questions.e: Hardly had he arrived when the crisis erupted. (Inversion after hardly.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “There is a large (amount / number) of unemployed graduates.”?
o: There is a large (amount / number) of unemployed graduates.
...a large number of unemployed graduates not.
questions.e: ...a large number of unemployed graduates. (graduates are countable.)

questions.s: Concision: saying it in fewer words
questions.q: Which replaces the nominalisation correctly?
o: The auditor carried out an examination of the accounts.
An examination of the accounts was carried out by the auditor.
The accounts were subject to examination by the auditor.
questions.e: One verb replaces a four-word noun phrase.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The corruption is the main obstacle to the development.”?
o: Corruption is the main obstacle to development.
Corruption are the main obstacle to development.
Corruption is not the main obstacle to development.
The corruption is the main obstacle to the development.
questions.e: Abstract nouns in general statements take no article.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The principle of the college addressed the students.”?
o: The principle of the college addressed the students.
The principal of the college.. not.
questions.e: The principal of the college... (Confused word: principal = head.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Poverty is one of the biggest problem in the Pakistan.”?
o: Poverty is one of the biggest problems in Pakistan.
Poverty is one of the biggest problem in the Pakistan.
Poverty is not one of the biggest problems in Pakistan.
Poverty are one of the biggest problems in Pakistan.
questions.e: One of the + plural noun, and a single-word country name takes no article.

questions.q: Which Direct Speech is associated with Rule “He said, "I am reading." → He said that he was reading.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 226: Direct Speech “Present Continuous” corresponds to Rule “He said, "I am reading." → He said that he was reading.”.

questions.q: The roads are still wet because it ____ all night.
questions.e: The present perfect continuous stresses the activity that produced the present result.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Between the four options, the third is the best.”?
o: Among the four options, the third are the best.
Among the four options, the third is not the best.
Between the four options, the third is the best.
Among the four options, the third is the best.
questions.e: Among the four options, the third is the best. (among for three or more.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “If I would have known, I would have informed you.”?
o: If I had known, I would have informed you.
If I had known, I would has informed you.
If I had not known, I would have informed you.
If I would have known, I would have informed you.
questions.e: Would never appears in the if-clause; the third conditional uses the past perfect.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “She is a woman of strong (principals / principles).”?
o: She is a woman of strong (principals / principles).
questions.e: ...a woman of strong principles. (principles = beliefs.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “He plays cricket and also the chess.”?
o: He plays cricket and also chess.
He plays cricket and also chess without.
He plays cricket and also chess not.
He plays cricket and also the chess.
questions.e: Games take no article. Only musical instruments take the.

questions.q: Which sentence states a prohibition?
o: You must not enter the examination hall with a phone.
You need not enter the examination hall with a phone.
You could not enter the hall with a phone.
You may not want to enter the hall with a phone.
questions.e: Must not forbids; need not merely removes an obligation.

questions.q: Which sentence correctly shows that the meeting ended before the minister arrived?
o: The meeting has ended before the minister arrived.
The meeting was ending before the minister arrived.
The meeting ended when the minister arrived.
The meeting had ended before the minister arrived.
questions.e: The past perfect marks the earlier of two past events.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The economy is growing since 2021.”?
o: The economy have been growing since 2021.
The economy has been growing since 2021.
The economy has not been growing since 2021.
questions.e: The economy has been growing since 2021. (Tense with since.)

questions.q: Which Sentence Type is associated with Clause Structure “One Independent Clause” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 233: Sentence Type “Simple Sentence” corresponds to Clause Structure “One Independent Clause”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The government should took action earlier.”?
o: The government should not have taken action earlier.
The government should has taken action earlier.
The government should have taken action earlier.
The government should took action earlier.
questions.e: A past obligation not met takes should have + past participle.

questions.q: Which Sentence Type is associated with Example “She reads books.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 233: Sentence Type “Simple Sentence” corresponds to Example “She reads books.”.

questions.q: Which Preposition is associated with Rule “Applied for a thing or purpose” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 232: Preposition “For” corresponds to Rule “Applied for a thing or purpose”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “She was admitted in the hospital after accident.”?
o: She was admitted to hospital after an accident.
She was admitted in the hospital after accident.
She was not admitted to hospital after an accident.
She were admitted to hospital after an accident.
questions.e: In hospital as a patient takes no article; accident is countable and needs one.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The reforms aim to reduce waste, improving efficiency, and to raise trust.”?
o: ...reduce waste, improve efficiency, and raise trust without.
...reduce waste, improve efficiency, and raise trust not.
The reforms aim to reduce waste, improving efficiency, and to raise trust.
...reduce waste, improve efficiency, and raise trust.
questions.e: ...reduce waste, improve efficiency, and raise trust. (Parallelism.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “He must to complete the assignment today.”?
o: He must not complete the assignment today.
He must complete the assignment today.
He must to complete the assignment today.
questions.e: A modal takes the bare infinitive, with no to.

questions.q: Which Direct Speech is associated with Rule “He said, "I play chess." → He said that he played chess.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 226: Direct Speech “Present Indefinite” corresponds to Rule “He said, "I play chess." → He said that he played chess.”.

questions.q: Six years ago, the ratio of the ages of Ali and Babar was 6:5. Four years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 11:10. What is Babar's age at present?
questions.e: Six years ago the ages were 6x and 5x. Four years later they will be 6x+10 and 5x+10. Their ratio 11:10 gives x=2; Babar is now 5x+6=16.

questions.q: 16 men and 12 women can complete a work in 20 days. 18 women can complete the same work in 40 days. In how many days will 12 men and 27 women complete the same work?
questions.e: The job equals 18×40=720 woman-days. A day with 16 men and 12 women does 720/20=36 woman-day units, so one man equals 1.5 women. Twelve men and 27 women equal 45 women, requiring 720/45=16 days.

questions.q: In a group of 200 people, 90 like tennis, while 108 like cricket and 46 people like both tennis and cricket. How many people like neither tennis nor cricket?
questions.e: By inclusion and exclusion, 90+108−46=152 like at least one game; 200−152=48 like neither.

questions.q: 450 visitors visit a museum on each Monday, while only 120 visit on each of the remaining six days of the week. How many visitors are there on a daily average basis in a month of 30 days beginning on a Monday?
questions.e: A 30-day month beginning Monday has five Mondays and 25 other days. (5×450+25×120)/30=175 visitors per day.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — Worker B takes 31 days for a task. Worker A is 20% more efficient than B. How many days would A need for the same task?
questions.e: Time varies inversely with efficiency, so A's time is 31 × 100/120 = 25.83 days.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — The mean of 14 observations in a report is 32. One entry, 22, is corrected to 50. What is the corrected mean?
questions.e: The total rises by 28; divided across 14 observations, the mean rises by 2 to 34.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — A vehicle covers two equal-distance legs at 26 km/h and 42 km/h. What is its average speed for the complete journey?
questions.e: For equal distances the harmonic mean applies: 2uv/(u + v) = 32.12 km/h.

questions.q: District-office worksheet — Worker B takes 32 days for a task. Worker A is 25% more efficient than B. How many days would A need for the same task?
questions.e: Time varies inversely with efficiency, so A's time is 32 × 100/125 = 25.6 days.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — The mean of 15 observations in a report is 33. One entry, 23, is corrected to 53. What is the corrected mean?
questions.e: The total rises by 30; divided across 15 observations, the mean rises by 2 to 35.

questions.q: Survey-unit review — A vehicle covers two equal-distance legs at 28 km/h and 38 km/h. What is its average speed for the complete journey?
questions.e: For equal distances the harmonic mean applies: 2uv/(u + v) = 32.24 km/h.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — On a coordinate grid, point Q lies 75 units east and 100 units north of point P. What is the straight-line distance PQ?
District-office worksheet — On a coordinate grid, point Q lies 130 units east and 312 units north of point P. What is the straight-line distance PQ?
Relief-camp planning case — For two years at 10% per annum, by how much does compound interest exceed simple interest on Rs 100000?
District-office worksheet — For two years at 12% per annum, by how much does compound interest exceed simple interest on Rs 110000?
Health-programme report — An arithmetic sequence begins 36, 41, 46, … . What is the sum of its first 17 terms?
Transport-depot calculation — An arithmetic sequence begins 35, 39, 43, … . What is the sum of its first 16 terms?
Relief-camp planning case — A 52 m by 22 m rectangular courtyard has a uniform path 2 m wide inside its boundary. What area does the path cover?
questions.e: Path area = outer area − inner area = 1144 − 48×18 = 280 m².

questions.q: District-office worksheet — An investment grows to Rs 1728 in two years at 20% compound interest per year. What was the principal?
District-office worksheet — A 53 m by 12 m rectangular courtyard has a uniform path 3 m wide inside its boundary. What area does the path cover?
questions.e: Path area = outer area − inner area = 636 − 47×6 = 354 m².
