questions.q: ان اصطلاحات—کهڑی زبر، کهڑی زیر، جزم / سکون، تنوین—میں درست اصطلاح اور تعریف کا جوڑا منتخب کریں۔
o: کهڑی زیر — وہ عالمت جو ساکن حرف پر لگائی جاتی ہے، آواز رک جاتی ہے۔
جزم / سکون — دو زبر، دو زیر یا دو پیش - آواز میں نون کی جھلک دیتی ہے۔
تنوین — مخصوص الفاظ میں زیر کی خاص صورت۔
کهڑی زبر — سیدھی لکیر جو مخصوص الفاظ میں زبر کی صورت میں آتی ہے۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 213: کهڑی زبر — سیدھی لکیر جو مخصوص الفاظ میں زبر کی صورت میں آتی ہے۔

questions.q:
Read the passage: “A food programme offered the same ration to every household. A review found that larger households exhausted it sooner. Officials then tested a formula that considered household size while preserving a guaranteed minimum for everyone.”

Why retain a guaranteed minimum?
o: To keep a basic entitlement for every household
questions.e: The minimum preserves universal basic coverage.

questions.q:
Read the passage: “A food programme offered the same ration to every household. A review found that larger households exhausted it sooner. Officials then tested a formula that considered household size while preserving a guaranteed minimum for everyone.”

Which limitation of the old policy prompted the review?
o: The minimum was too generous for all
Equal rations did not meet unequal household needs
questions.e: The same ration lasted different lengths of time in households of different sizes.

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Preposition “Of” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 232: Rule “Legal or moral state/status” corresponds to Preposition “Of”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Definition “Refers to things you can touch or see” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 229: Type “Concrete Noun” corresponds to Definition “Refers to things you can touch or see”.

questions.q: Which Example Sentence is associated with Rule “No article before man/woman (used generally)” in the English reference?
o: I saw a certain bird flying high. A certain man was looking for you.
He is a teacher. She bought a university bag. (Note: "University" starts with a consonant sound /juː/)
He hopes to go to heaven. We must fear God.
Man is mortal. Woman has always played a vital role.
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 225: Example Sentence “Man is mortal. Woman has always played a vital role.” corresponds to Rule “No article before man/woman (used generally)”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “We can solve this only by working together. (Inversion with only by.)”?
o: We can solve this only by working together. (Inversion with only by.)
Only by working together can we solve this.
Only by working together can we solve .
Only by working together can not we solve this.
questions.e: Only by working together can we solve this. (Invert after only by.)

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Reporting Verb “Exclaimed with Sorrow” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 228: Type “Sorrow” corresponds to Reporting Verb “Exclaimed with Sorrow”.

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Example Sentence “The man you saw was my teacher. The pen on the desk is mine.” in the English reference?
o: Use the with names of famous books
Use the with a class of animals, birds, or objects
Use the with a class of people
Use the when speaking of a known person or thing
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 225: Rule “Use the when speaking of a known person or thing” corresponds to Example Sentence “The man you saw was my teacher. The pen on the desk is mine.”.

questions.q: Which Direct Speech is associated with Indirect Speech “He asked where I was going.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 227: Direct Speech “He said, "Where are you going?"” corresponds to Indirect Speech “He asked where I was going.”.

questions.q: Which Tense is associated with Structure “subject + was/were + verb-ing” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 244: Tense “Past Continuous” corresponds to Structure “subject + was/were + verb-ing”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Example Word “by, with” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 231: Type “Preposition of Manner” corresponds to Example Word “by, with”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Definition “Shows movement” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 231: Type “Preposition of Direction” corresponds to Definition “Shows movement”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Sentence Example “I run every morning.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Action Verb” corresponds to Sentence Example “I run every morning.”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Definition “Describes how often action happens” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Adverb of Frequency” corresponds to Definition “Describes how often action happens”.

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Examples (with Prepositions Highlighted) “He compared one type of mango with another.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 233: Rule “Comparison between similar things” corresponds to Examples (with Prepositions Highlighted) “He compared one type of mango with another.”.

questions.q: Which Part of Speech is associated with Explanation “Shows sudden feelings or reactions” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 229: Part of Speech “Interjection” corresponds to Explanation “Shows sudden feelings or reactions”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Definition “Points to specific things” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Demonstrative Pronoun” corresponds to Definition “Points to specific things”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The authorities should took notice earlier; the damage can have been avoided.”?
o: The authorities should not have taken notice earlier; the damage could have been avoided.
The authorities should took notice earlier; the damage can have been avoided.
The authorities should have taken notice earlier; the damage could have been avoided.
The authorities should has taken notice earlier; the damage could have been avoided.
questions.e: Past obligation and past unrealised possibility both take modal + have + participle.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Item 10 hedging/modality (Day 19)”?
o: This strongly suggests the policy worked. / ...may have worked.
This strongly suggests the policy worked. / ...may has worked.
This strongly suggests the policy worked. / ...may not have worked.
questions.e: This strongly suggests the policy worked. / ...may have worked. (Measured.)

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Examples (with Prepositions Highlighted) “People in our city travel mostly by train.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 233: Rule “Non-specific vehicle travel” corresponds to Examples (with Prepositions Highlighted) “People in our city travel mostly by train.”.

questions.q: Which Tense is associated with Passive Formula “Object + was/were + being + V3 + by + Subject” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 224: Tense “Past Continuous” corresponds to Passive Formula “Object + was/were + being + V3 + by + Subject”.

questions.s: Present and past: the four forms of each
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Last year the rupee is depreciating by thirty per cent.”?
o: Last year rupee depreciated by thirty per cent.
Last year the rupee depreciated by thirty per cent not.
Last year the rupee is depreciating by thirty per cent.
Last year the rupee depreciated by thirty per cent.
questions.e: Last year is a finished time, so the past simple is required.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “I look forward to hear from you.”?
o: I look forward to hearing from you not.
I look forward than hearing from you.
I look forward to hearing from you.
I look forward to hear from you.
questions.e: To here is a preposition and takes the -ing form.

questions.q: Which Direct Speech is associated with Indirect Speech “He ordered not to smoke.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 228: Direct Speech “He said, "Don't smoke."” corresponds to Indirect Speech “He ordered not to smoke.”.

questions.s: Present and past: the four forms of each
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “I am having two brothers and one sister.”?
o: I has two brothers and one sister.
I have not two brothers and one sister.
I am having two brothers and one sister.
I have two brothers and one sister.
questions.e: Have meaning “possess” is stative and has no continuous form.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Let me tell you that this policy is totally useless.”?
o: policy achieves none of its stated objectives.
This policy achieves none of its stated objectives not.
Let me tell you that this policy is totally useless.
This policy achieves none of its stated objectives.
questions.e: Direct address and overstatement replaced by a specific claim.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Sentence Example “I like tea and coffee.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 231: Type “Coordinating Conjunction” corresponds to Sentence Example “I like tea and coffee.”.

questions.s: Present and past: the four forms of each
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The author is arguing in chapter three that democracy is fragile.”?
o: The author is arguing in chapter three that democracy is fragile.
The author argues in chapter three that democracy is not fragile.
The author argues in chapter three that democracy are fragile.
The author argues in chapter three that democracy is fragile.
questions.e: Discussion of a text uses the literary present simple.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The committee comprises of five members who compose the report.”?
o: The committee comprises of five members who compose the report.
The committee comprises five members, who compose the report not.
committee comprises five members, who compose the report.
The committee comprises five members, who compose the report.
questions.e: Comprise takes no of, and the parts compose the whole.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The committee suggested that the deputy director is removed from the inquiry.”?
o: The committee suggested that the deputy director be removed from the inquiry not.
committee suggested that the deputy director be removed from the inquiry.
The committee suggested that the deputy director be removed from the inquiry.
The committee suggested that the deputy director is removed from the inquiry.
questions.e: Suggest takes the subjunctive bare form in the that-clause.

questions.s: Present and past: the four forms of each
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “He did not attended the meeting yesterday.”?
o: He did not attend meeting yesterday.
He did not attend the meeting yesterday not.
He did not attended the meeting yesterday.
He did not attend the meeting yesterday.
questions.e: Did already carries the past tense, so the main verb returns to its base form.

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Examples (with Prepositions Highlighted) “I stayed in Dubai for five days.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 233: Rule “Longer residential stay” corresponds to Examples (with Prepositions Highlighted) “I stayed in Dubai for five days.”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “There has been continuous load-shedding every evening for a month.”?
o: There have been continual load-shedding every evening for a month.
There has not been continual load-shedding every evening for a month.
There has been continuous load-shedding every evening for a month.
There has been continual load-shedding every evening for a month.
questions.e: Repeated interruptions are continual; unbroken ones are continuous.

questions.s: Present and past: the four forms of each
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “While I was writing the answer, the bell rang and I was stopping.”?
o: While I was writing the answer, the bell rang and I was stopping.
While I was not writing the answer, the bell rang and I stopped.
While I were writing the answer, the bell rang and I stopped.
While I was writing the answer, the bell rang and I stopped.
questions.e: The short completed action takes the past simple.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The govt didn’t do anything about this big problem.”?
o: The govt didn’t do anything about this big problem.
The government took every action on this serious problem.
government took no action on this serious problem.
The government took no action on this serious problem.
questions.e: Abbreviation, contraction and casual wording all removed.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Item 5 comparative for two (Day 20)”?
o: Of the two policies, this is the better one.
Of the two policies, this are the better one.
Of the two policies, this is not the better one.
questions.e: Of the two policies, this is the better one. (Comparative for two.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Everyone knows that corruption is the worst problem in the world.”?
o: Corruption are widely regarded as one of the most damaging obstacles to development.
Corruption is not widely regarded as one of the most damaging obstacles to development.
Everyone knows that corruption is the worst problem in the world.
Corruption is widely regarded as one of the most damaging obstacles to development.
questions.e: The claim is now defensible rather than absolute.

questions.q: Which Direct Speech is associated with Indirect Speech “She asked what my name was.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 227: Direct Speech “She said, "What is your name?"” corresponds to Indirect Speech “She asked what my name was.”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Item 4 perfect modal meaning (Day 19)”?
o: The crisis could have been avoided if we had acted.
The crisis could not have been avoided if we had acted.
The crisis could has been avoided if we had acted.
questions.e: The crisis could have been avoided if we had acted. (Unrealised past possibility, not deduction.)

questions.s: Future forms and the sequence of tenses
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “By next month we will complete the survey.”?
o: By next month we will has completed the survey.
By next month we will not have completed the survey.
By next month we will complete the survey.
By next month we will have completed the survey.
questions.e: By + a future point marks completion, so the future perfect is required.

questions.q: Which Indirect Speech is associated with Direct Speech “Come” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 227: Indirect Speech “Go” corresponds to Direct Speech “Come”.

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Example Sentence “He is suffering from malaria. She has diabetes.” in the English reference?
o: Exceptions: article the is used with measles, mumps
No article before common diseases (except a few)
No article before hell, heaven, or God (used reverently)
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 225: Rule “No article before common diseases (except a few)” corresponds to Example Sentence “He is suffering from malaria. She has diabetes.”.

questions.s: Future forms and the sequence of tenses
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The teacher said that the earth revolved around the sun.”?
o: teacher said that the earth revolves around the sun.
The teacher said that the earth revolves around the sun not.
The teacher said that the earth revolved around the sun.
The teacher said that the earth revolves around the sun.
questions.e: A permanent truth keeps the present tense even after a past reporting verb.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Sentence Example “You can have either tea or coffee.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 231: Type “Correlative Conjunction” corresponds to Sentence Example “You can have either tea or coffee.”.

questions.s: Verb Tense System and Sequence of Tenses
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “After the policy failed, the government revises its strategy.”?
o: After the policy failed, the government revises its strategy.
After the policy failed, the government revised its strategy.
After policy failed, the government revised its strategy.
After the policy failed, the government revised its strategy not.
questions.e: After the policy failed, the government revised its strategy. (Consistent past.)

questions.q: Which Structure is associated with Tense “Present Perfect Continuous” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 244: Structure “subject + has/have been + verb-ing” corresponds to Tense “Present Perfect Continuous”.

questions.q: Which Sentence Type is associated with Example “Although it rained, we went outside, and we enjoyed the walk.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 234: Sentence Type “Compound- Complex Sentence” corresponds to Example “Although it rained, we went outside, and we enjoyed the walk.”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Item 4 misplaced modifier (Day 11)”?
o: He read almost the whole report.
He read almost the whole report not.
questions.e: He read almost the whole report. (almost modifies the whole report, not read.)

questions.s: Verb Tense System and Sequence of Tenses
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Since 2015, the government implemented several austerity measures.”?
o: Since 2015, the government implemented several austerity measures.
Since 2015, the government has implemented several austerity measures.
Since 2015, the government have implemented several austerity measures.
Since 2015, the government has not implemented several austerity measures.
questions.e: Since 2015, the government has implemented several austerity measures. (Since + present perfect.)

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Example Sentence “He hopes to go to heaven. We must fear God.” in the English reference?
o: Exception: article the is used with "devil"
No article before hell, heaven, or God (used reverently)
Use the with countries having "States", "Kingdom", or plurals
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 225: Rule “No article before hell, heaven, or God (used reverently)” corresponds to Example Sentence “He hopes to go to heaven. We must fear God.”.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — Worker B takes 55 days for a task. Worker A is 20% more efficient than B. How many days would A need for the same task?
questions.e: Time varies inversely with efficiency, so A's time is 55 × 100/120 = 45.83 days.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — Worker B takes 58 days for a task. Worker A is 100% more efficient than B. How many days would A need for the same task?
questions.e: Time varies inversely with efficiency, so A's time is 58 × 100/200 = 29 days.

questions.q: District-office worksheet — An arithmetic sequence begins 38, 45, 52, … . What is the sum of its first 11 terms?
Relief-camp planning case — An arithmetic sequence begins 37, 43, 49, … . What is the sum of its first 10 terms?
Transport-depot calculation — An investment grows to Rs 40000 in two years at 25% compound interest per year. What was the principal?
Warehouse planning case — An investment grows to Rs 4500 in two years at 50% compound interest per year. What was the principal?
Relief-camp planning case — A bag holds 19 red and 6 blue counters. Two are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
questions.e: Multiply the changing probabilities: 19/25 × 18/24 = 57%.

questions.q: District-office worksheet — A bag holds 20 red and 7 blue counters. Two are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
questions.e: Multiply the changing probabilities: 20/27 × 19/26 = 54.13%.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — A invests Rs 55000 for 7 months and B invests Rs 7000 for 6 months. If their profit is Rs 4270, what is A's share?
questions.e: Profit follows capital-months. The weights are 385000:42000; A therefore receives Rs 3850.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — A invests Rs 54000 for 6 months and B invests Rs 6000 for 5 months. If their profit is Rs 3540, what is A's share?
questions.e: Profit follows capital-months. The weights are 324000:30000; A therefore receives Rs 3240.

questions.q: Survey-unit review — The roots of x² − 67x + 1116 = 0 differ by 5. What is the larger root?
questions.e: The quadratic factors as (x − 31)(x − 36); the larger root is 36.

questions.q: Training-centre exercise — The roots of x² − 70x + 1216 = 0 differ by 6. What is the larger root?
questions.e: The quadratic factors as (x − 32)(x − 38); the larger root is 38.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — A geometric sequence has first term 52 and common ratio 4. What is its 7th term?
Warehouse planning case — A geometric sequence has first term 53 and common ratio 2. What is its 8th term?
Warehouse planning case — A two-digit number has digit sum 11; reversing its digits reduces it by 27. What is the original number?
questions.e: Let the tens and units digits be x and y. Then x + y = 11 and 9(x − y) = 27; hence x = 7, y = 4.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — A two-digit number has digit sum 10; reversing its digits reduces it by 36. What is the original number?
questions.e: Let the tens and units digits be x and y. Then x + y = 10 and 9(x − y) = 36; hence x = 7, y = 3.

questions.q: Survey-unit review — The mean of 20 observations in a report is 74. One entry, 64, is corrected to 104. What is the corrected mean?
questions.e: The total rises by 40; divided across 20 observations, the mean rises by 2 to 76.

questions.q: Training-centre exercise — The mean of 12 observations in a report is 75. One entry, 65, is corrected to 89. What is the corrected mean?
questions.e: The total rises by 24; divided across 12 observations, the mean rises by 2 to 77.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — A train 680 m long clears a 100 m platform in 11 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
questions.e: The train covers 780 m. Its speed is (780)/11 m/s × 3.6 = 255.27 km/h.

questions.q: District-office worksheet — A train 210 m long clears a 80 m platform in 19 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
questions.e: The train covers 290 m. Its speed is (290)/19 m/s × 3.6 = 54.95 km/h.

questions.q: Transport-depot calculation — A 50 m by 20 m rectangular courtyard has a uniform path 4 m wide inside its boundary. What area does the path cover?
questions.e: Path area = outer area − inner area = 1000 − 42×12 = 496 m².

questions.q: Health-programme report — A 51 m by 21 m rectangular courtyard has a uniform path 5 m wide inside its boundary. What area does the path cover?
questions.e: Path area = outer area − inner area = 1071 − 41×11 = 620 m².

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — On a coordinate grid, point Q lies 364 units east and 1248 units north of point P. What is the straight-line distance PQ?
Scholarship-fund audit — On a coordinate grid, point Q lies 408 units east and 765 units north of point P. What is the straight-line distance PQ?
Warehouse planning case — For two years at 20% per annum, by how much does compound interest exceed simple interest on Rs 530000?
Scholarship-fund audit — For two years at 15% per annum, by how much does compound interest exceed simple interest on Rs 520000?
District-office worksheet — 84 passengers paid Rs 3900. An adult ticket cost Rs 50 and a child ticket Rs 30. How many adults travelled?
questions.e: If a is the adult count, 50a + 30(84 − a) = 3900, which gives a = 69.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — 82 passengers paid Rs 6280. An adult ticket cost Rs 80 and a child ticket Rs 60. How many adults travelled?
questions.e: If a is the adult count, 80a + 60(82 − a) = 6280, which gives a = 68.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — After a 30% discount and then 20% sales tax, an equipment bill for a warehouse is Rs 37800. What was the listed price?
questions.e: If L is the list price, L × 70/100 × 120/100 = 37800, giving L = 45000.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — After a 10% discount and then 5% sales tax, an equipment bill for a relief camp is Rs 39690. What was the listed price?
questions.e: If L is the list price, L × 90/100 × 105/100 = 39690, giving L = 42000.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — A vehicle covers two equal-distance legs at 36 km/h and 46 km/h. What is its average speed for the complete journey?
questions.e: For equal distances the harmonic mean applies: 2uv/(u + v) = 40.39 km/h.

questions.q: District-office worksheet — A vehicle covers two equal-distance legs at 38 km/h and 50 km/h. What is its average speed for the complete journey?
questions.e: For equal distances the harmonic mean applies: 2uv/(u + v) = 43.18 km/h.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — Two batches assessed by a relief camp contain 52 and 15 candidates with mean scores 60 and 76. What is the combined mean?
questions.e: Use the weighted mean: (52 × 60 + 15 × 76) ÷ 67 = 63.58.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — Two batches assessed by a warehouse contain 55 and 18 candidates with mean scores 52 and 79. What is the combined mean?
questions.e: Use the weighted mean: (55 × 52 + 18 × 79) ÷ 73 = 58.66.

questions.q: Training-centre exercise — A boat's still-water speed is 15 km/h and the stream flows at 2 km/h. How long does a 663 km upstream and 663 km downstream round trip take?
Transport-depot calculation — a transport depot must select 3 representatives from 12 eligible people. If order does not matter, how many different committees are possible?
Health-programme report — A tank contains 380 litres of a 40% solution. 76 litres of the mixture are removed and replaced by water. What is the new concentration?
questions.e: Removing one-fifth of a uniform mixture removes one-fifth of its solute. The remaining concentration is 40% × 4/5 = 32%.

questions.q: District-office worksheet — A tank contains 560 litres of a 30% solution. 112 litres of the mixture are removed and replaced by water. What is the new concentration?
questions.e: Removing one-fifth of a uniform mixture removes one-fifth of its solute. The remaining concentration is 30% × 4/5 = 24%.

questions.q: Survey-unit review — A boat's still-water speed is 70 km/h and the stream flows at 2 km/h. How long does a 4896 km upstream and 4896 km downstream round trip take?
Transport-depot calculation — a transport depot divides 600 files between teams A and B in the ratio 5:7. How many additional files must A receive for the new ratio A:B to become 10:7?
questions.e: The original shares are 250 and 350. To make A's share 500, it needs 500 − 250 = 250 more files.

questions.q: Health-programme report — a health programme must select 4 representatives from 12 eligible people. If order does not matter, how many different committees are possible?
Health-programme report — a health programme divides 714 files between teams A and B in the ratio 6:8. How many additional files must A receive for the new ratio A:B to become 12:8?
questions.e: The original shares are 306 and 408. To make A's share 612, it needs 612 − 306 = 306 more files.

questions.q: Five candidates—Usman, Waleed, Yasir, Zain, Zara—are interviewed once each. Usman is before Waleed; Waleed is immediately before Yasir; Zara is after Zain; and Zain is after Yasir. Which order is possible?
questions.e: The fixed block is Waleed–Yasir; Usman must precede it, and Yasir must be followed in order by Zain and Zara.

questions.q: Survey-unit review — A supplier wants a 20% profit on an item costing Rs 17600, even after allowing a 20% discount on its marked price. What marked price is required?
questions.e: Required selling price is 17600 × 120/100. Since that is 80% of the marked price, divide it by 0.8.

questions.q: Five candidates—Umar, Usman, Waleed, Yasir, Zain—are interviewed once each. Umar is before Usman; Usman is immediately before Waleed; Zain is after Yasir; and Yasir is after Waleed. Which order is possible?
questions.e: The fixed block is Usman–Waleed; Umar must precede it, and Waleed must be followed in order by Yasir and Zain.

questions.q: Training-centre exercise — A supplier wants a 25% profit on an item costing Rs 18400, even after allowing a 25% discount on its marked price. What marked price is required?
questions.e: Required selling price is 18400 × 125/100. Since that is 75% of the marked price, divide it by 0.75.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — Two runners start together in opposite directions on a 940 m circular track at 156.67 m/s and 117.5 m/s. After how many seconds do they first meet?
questions.e: In opposite directions their relative speed is 274.17 m/s, so time is 940 ÷ 274.17 = 3.43 seconds.

questions.q: Survey-unit review — Two runners start together in opposite directions on a 1340 m circular track at 223.33 m/s and 167.5 m/s. After how many seconds do they first meet?
questions.e: In opposite directions their relative speed is 390.83 m/s, so time is 1340 ÷ 390.83 = 3.43 seconds.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — What is the least number greater than 20 that leaves remainder 3 when divided by both 4 and 5, given that 4 and 5 are coprime?
questions.e: A common remainder means N − 3 is a multiple of lcm(4, 5) = 20. The least eligible N is 20 + 3 = 23.

questions.q: Training-centre exercise — What is the least number greater than 56 that leaves remainder 6 when divided by both 7 and 8, given that 7 and 8 are coprime?

questions.q:
Read the passage: “A factory replaced an old machine that consumed less electricity per unit of output. Orders then increased, and the factory’s overall electricity bill rose. The manager separated the efficiency measure from the total bill when reporting results.”

How can the total bill rise despite better efficiency?
o: Total production can increase enough to outweigh per-unit savings
Electricity use per unit must have risen
An efficient machine uses no energy
questions.e: A larger volume of output may more than offset lower energy use per unit.

questions.q:
Read the passage: “A factory replaced an old machine that consumed less electricity per unit of output. Orders then increased, and the factory’s overall electricity bill rose. The manager separated the efficiency measure from the total bill when reporting results.”

Which figure measures the new machine’s efficiency most directly?
questions.e: Per-unit energy use measures the stated efficiency improvement.

questions.s: Modifiers: put the describing words where they belong
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “He only completed two of the five questions.”?
o: He completed only two of the five questions not.
He only completed two of the five questions.
He completed only two of the five questions.
He completed only two of five questions.
questions.e: Only limits the number, so it belongs beside two.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Each of the schools have received new funding.”?
o: Each of the schools has received new funding.
Each of the schools have received new funding.
Each of the schools has not received new funding.
Each of the schools has received new funding without.
questions.e: Each of the schools has received new funding. (Each is singular.)

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Preposition “Off” in the English reference?
o: Used when some work is finished, or for disconnection/cutting
Used for position on a surface
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 231: Rule “Used when some work is finished, or for disconnection/cutting” corresponds to Preposition “Off”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The list of approved candidates were published yesterday.”?
o: The list of approved candidates was published yesterday.
The list of approved candidates was published yesterday without.
The list of approved candidates was not published yesterday.
The list of approved candidates were published yesterday.
questions.e: The list of approved candidates was published yesterday. (Subject = list.)

questions.s: Modifiers: put the describing words where they belong
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The officer explained the rules to the applicants which were complicated.”?
o: The officer explained the complicated rules to the applicants not.
The officer explained the rules to the applicants which were complicated.
The officer explained the complicated rules to the applicants.
The officer explained the complicated rules than the applicants.
questions.e: The relative clause sat beside applicants instead of rules.

questions.s: Modifiers: put the describing words where they belong
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Walking along the canal, the trees looked beautiful.”?
o: Walking along the canal, we thought the trees looked beautiful not.
Walking along canal, we thought the trees looked beautiful.
Walking along the canal, we thought the trees looked beautiful.
Walking along the canal, the trees looked beautiful.
questions.e: Trees do not walk. The doer must follow the comma.

questions.q: Which comparison is parallel?
o: Drafting a summary is harder than a note.
To draft a summary is harder than drafting a note.
Drafting a summary is harder than drafting a note.
Drafting a summary is harder than to draft a note.
questions.e: Both sides are gerund phrases.

questions.q: Which Indirect Speech is associated with Direct Speech “Past Indefinite” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 226: Indirect Speech “Past Perfect” corresponds to Direct Speech “Past Indefinite”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Definition “Used for greetings” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 231: Type “Greeting Interjection” corresponds to Definition “Used for greetings”.

questions.s: Modifiers: put the describing words where they belong
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “To pass the examination, hard work is necessary.”?
o: To pass the examination, a candidate must not work hard.
To pass the examination, hard work is necessary.
To pass the examination, a candidate must work hard.
than pass the examination, a candidate must work hard.
questions.e: Hard work does not pass an examination; a candidate does.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Corruption is widespread, it undermines public trust.”?
o: Corruption is widespread, and it undermines public trust. / Corruption is widespread; it undermines public trust.
Corruption are widespread, and it undermines public trust. / Corruption is widespread; it undermines public trust.
Corruption is not widespread, and it undermines public trust. / Corruption is widespread; it undermines public trust.
Corruption is widespread, it undermines public trust.
questions.e: Corruption is widespread, and it undermines public trust. / Corruption is widespread; it undermines public trust. (Fix the comma splice.)

questions.q: Which Tense is associated with Example “She writes daily.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 244: Tense “Present Simple” corresponds to Example “She writes daily.”.

questions.s: Modifiers: put the describing words where they belong
questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “This is the most unique document in the archive.”?
o: This is not the only document of its kind in the archive.
This are the only document of its kind in the archive.
This is the only document of its kind in the archive.
This is the most unique document in the archive.
questions.e: Unique is absolute and takes no comparative or superlative.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Item 6 countable/uncountable + article (Day 12)”?
questions.e: She gave useful advice. (advice is uncountable no a.)

questions.q: Which Preposition is associated with Rule “Used for relationships” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 232: Preposition “To” corresponds to Rule “Used for relationships”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Item 7 preposition (Day 13)”?
o: The policy resulted in a crisis not.
The policy resulted in an crisis.
The policy resulted in a crisis.
questions.e: The policy resulted in a crisis. (result in.)

questions.q: Which Preposition is associated with Rule “Specific address” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 232: Preposition “At” corresponds to Rule “Specific address”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The population of Lahore is greater than Karachi.”?
o: The population of Lahore is greater than that of Karachi.
The population of Lahore is greater than Karachi.
The population of Lahore is not greater than that of Karachi.
The population of Lahore are greater than that of Karachi.
questions.e: A population must be compared with a population, not with a city.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “He is more taller than his elder brother.”?
o: He is not taller than his elder brother.
He is more taller than his elder brother.
He is taller than his elder brother.
He are taller than his elder brother.
questions.e: A double comparative is never correct.

questions.s: Present and past: the four forms of each
questions.q: The file ____ four annexures and a covering note.
questions.e: Contain is stative and takes the simple form.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Item 2 dangling participle (Day 10/11)”?
o: Walking to the office, the minister were soaked by the rain.
Walking to the office, the minister was not soaked by the rain.
Walking to the office, the minister was soaked by the rain.
questions.e: Walking to the office, the minister was soaked by the rain. (The subject must be the one walking.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Karachi is bigger than any city in Pakistan.”?
o: Karachi is bigger than any other city in Pakistan.
Karachi is bigger than any city in Pakistan.
Karachi is not bigger than any other city in Pakistan.
Karachi are bigger than any other city in Pakistan.
questions.e: Karachi belongs to the group, so any other is required.

questions.q: Which Tense is associated with Example (Active) “They built a house.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 224: Tense “Past Indefinite” corresponds to Example (Active) “They built a house.”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Item 3 verbal form (Day 10)”?
o: The report needs revising / needs to be revised before submission not.
The report needs revising / needs than be revised before submission.
The report needs revising / needs to be revised before submission.
questions.e: The report needs revising / needs to be revised before submission. (needs + gerund or needs to be + participle.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “This is one of the better essays I have read this year.”?
o: This is not one of the best essays I have read this year.
This is one of the better essays I have read this year.
This is one of the best essays I have read this year.
This is one of the best essays I has read this year.
questions.e: One of the + superlative + plural noun is the fixed pattern.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Of the two candidates, he is the best.”?
o: Of the two candidates, he is the better.
Of the two candidates, he is the best.
Of the two candidates, he is not the better.
Of the two candidates, he are the better.
questions.e: Two items take the comparative.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Item 1 voice (Day 9)”?
o: The board decided to merge the two departments not.
The board decided than merge the two departments.
The board decided to merge the two departments.
questions.e: The board decided to merge the two departments. (Active voice names the actor.)

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Example Word “bigger” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Comparative Adjective” corresponds to Example Word “bigger”.

questions.q: Which sentence correctly reports “Let us postpone the meeting”?
o: He asked to postpone the meeting that.
He told that they postpone the meeting.
He suggested that the meeting should be postponed.
He said let us postpone the meeting.
questions.e: Let us is reported with suggest + that-clause or suggest + -ing.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Example “He said, "Close the door." → He ordered to close the door.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 228: Type “Order” corresponds to Example “He said, "Close the door." → He ordered to close the door.”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The writer argued that enforcement is weak and he says the law is adequate.”?
o: The writer argued that enforcement is weak and he says the law is adequate.
The writer argues that enforcement is weak although the law is adequate.
The writer argues that enforcement are weak although the law is adequate.
The writer argues that enforcement is not weak although the law is adequate.
questions.e: The tense frame must be held steady, and the contrast must be shown.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The scheme failed.”?
o: scheme, launched in 2019, failed in most districts within two years.
The scheme, launched in 2019, failed in most districts within two years.
The scheme, launched in 2019, failed in most districts within two years not.
questions.e: Over-compression has removed three qualifications that the passage supplied.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The government didn’t really get its act together on the economy.”?
o: The government failed to manage the economy effectively not.
The government didn’t really get its act together on the economy.
The government failed to manage the economy effectively.
The government failed than manage the economy effectively.
questions.e: The government failed to manage the economy effectively. (Slang removed.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “He asked whether the project had failed.”?
o: He asked whether the project had failed.
Correct an indirect question ends with a period, not a question mark.
Correct a indirect question ends with a period, not a question mark.
Correct an indirect question ends with a period, not a question mark not.
questions.e: Correct an indirect question ends with a period, not a question mark.

questions.q: Which sentence keeps voice consistent?
o: The section officer examined the file and the deputy secretary approved it.
The file was examined by the section officer and the deputy secretary approved it.
The section officer examined the file and it was approved by the deputy secretary.
The file was examined by the section officer and approved the deputy secretary.
questions.e: Both clauses stay active, so the sentence reads as one movement.

questions.q: Which Rule is associated with Example Sentence “He plays the piano beautifully.” in the English reference?
o: With proper nouns used in a descriptive sense
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 225: Rule “With musical instruments” corresponds to Example Sentence “He plays the piano beautifully.”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Example Word “France” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 229: Type “Proper Noun” corresponds to Example Word “France”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Announced in 2019 and never funded, failing within two years.”?
o: Announced in 2019 and never funded, failing within two years.
Announced in 2019 and never funded, the scheme failed within two years.
Announced in 2019 and never funded, scheme failed within two years.
Announced in 2019 and never funded, the scheme failed within two years not.
questions.e: The compressed version had no subject or finite verb.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The passage shows that the policy failed, the reasons were structural.”?
o: passage shows that the policy failed for structural reasons.
The passage shows that the policy failed for structural reasons.
The passage shows that the policy failed, the reasons were structural.
The passage shows that the policy failed for structural reasons not.
questions.e: Compression had produced a comma splice.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Kids these days don’t have a lot of job options.”?
o: Young people today have not few employment opportunities.
Kids these days don’t have a lot of job options.
Young people today have few employment opportunities.
Young people today has few employment opportunities.
questions.e: Young people today have few employment opportunities. (Formal and clear.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The writer says that we should improve enforcement, and I agree with him.”?
o: writer argues that enforcement should be improved.
The writer argues that enforcement should be improved.
The writer says that we should improve enforcement, and I agree with him.
The writer argues that enforcement should not be improved.
questions.e: A précis carries no opinion of your own.

questions.q: Which Direct Speech is associated with Indirect Speech “He says that he likes tea.” in the English reference?
o: He said, "The sun rises in the east."
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 226: Direct Speech “He says, "I like tea."” corresponds to Indirect Speech “He says that he likes tea.”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Example Word “run” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Action Verb” corresponds to Example Word “run”.

questions.q: Which group of words is a complete sentence?
o: Although the budget was approved in March.
The budget approved in March by the assembly.
The budget was approved in March.
Approving the budget in March despite objections.
questions.e: Only option C has a subject and a finite verb and does not begin with a subordinator.

questions.q: What the tribunal decided in those two cases ____ still disputed.
questions.e: The subject is the whole what-clause, which counts as one singular idea.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Example Word “outside” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Adverb of Place” corresponds to Example Word “outside”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “What the economy needs are structural reforms.”?
o: What the economy needs is structural reforms.
What the economy needs are structural reforms.
What the economy needs is not structural reforms.
What the economy needs is structural reforms without.
questions.e: What the economy needs is structural reforms. (The noun clause What the economy needs is singular.)

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “When we reached the venue, the ceremony already started.”?
o: When we reached venue, the ceremony had already started.
When we reached the venue, the ceremony had not already started.
When we reached the venue, the ceremony already started.
When we reached the venue, the ceremony had already started.
questions.e: The earlier of two past events takes the past perfect.

questions.q: Health-programme report — On a coordinate grid, point Q lies 336 units east and 1152 units north of point P. What is the straight-line distance PQ?
District-office worksheet — On a coordinate grid, point Q lies 290 units east and 696 units north of point P. What is the straight-line distance PQ?
Warehouse planning case — A vehicle covers two equal-distance legs at 138 km/h and 154 km/h. What is its average speed for the complete journey?
questions.e: For equal distances the harmonic mean applies: 2uv/(u + v) = 145.56 km/h.

questions.q: Survey-unit review — A 56 m by 15 m rectangular courtyard has a uniform path 2 m wide inside its boundary. What area does the path cover?
questions.e: Path area = outer area − inner area = 840 − 52×11 = 268 m².

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — A 36 m by 17 m rectangular courtyard has a uniform path 2 m wide inside its boundary. What area does the path cover?
questions.e: Path area = outer area − inner area = 612 − 32×13 = 196 m².

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — A vehicle covers two equal-distance legs at 136 km/h and 150 km/h. What is its average speed for the complete journey?
questions.e: For equal distances the harmonic mean applies: 2uv/(u + v) = 142.66 km/h.

questions.q: Training-centre exercise — Worker B takes 36 days for a task. Worker A is 25% more efficient than B. How many days would A need for the same task?
questions.e: Time varies inversely with efficiency, so A's time is 36 × 100/125 = 28.8 days.

questions.q: Survey-unit review — Worker B takes 35 days for a task. Worker A is 20% more efficient than B. How many days would A need for the same task?
questions.e: Time varies inversely with efficiency, so A's time is 35 × 100/120 = 29.17 days.

questions.q: Health-programme report — The roots of x² − 71x + 1258 = 0 differ by 3. What is the larger root?
questions.e: The quadratic factors as (x − 34)(x − 37); the larger root is 37.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — An arithmetic sequence begins 16, 22, 28, … . What is the sum of its first 13 terms?
Transport-depot calculation — The roots of x² − 68x + 1155 = 0 differ by 2. What is the larger root?
questions.e: The quadratic factors as (x − 33)(x − 35); the larger root is 35.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — An arithmetic sequence begins 15, 20, 25, … . What is the sum of its first 12 terms?
Warehouse planning case — A invests Rs 15000 for 7 months and B invests Rs 9000 for 8 months. If their profit is Rs 1770, what is A's share?
questions.e: Profit follows capital-months. The weights are 105000:72000; A therefore receives Rs 1050.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — A invests Rs 14000 for 6 months and B invests Rs 8000 for 7 months. If their profit is Rs 1400, what is A's share?
questions.e: Profit follows capital-months. The weights are 84000:56000; A therefore receives Rs 840.

questions.q: Health-programme report — A bag holds 26 red and 6 blue counters. Two are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
questions.e: Multiply the changing probabilities: 26/32 × 25/31 = 65.52%.

questions.q: Transport-depot calculation — A bag holds 25 red and 5 blue counters. Two are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
questions.e: Multiply the changing probabilities: 25/30 × 24/29 = 68.97%.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — Two batches assessed by a warehouse contain 39 and 11 candidates with mean scores 58 and 76. What is the combined mean?
questions.e: Use the weighted mean: (39 × 58 + 11 × 76) ÷ 50 = 61.96.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — Two batches assessed by a relief camp contain 36 and 17 candidates with mean scores 55 and 73. What is the combined mean?
questions.e: Use the weighted mean: (36 × 55 + 17 × 73) ÷ 53 = 60.77.

questions.q: Training-centre exercise — For two years at 12% per annum, by how much does compound interest exceed simple interest on Rs 550000?
Survey-unit review — For two years at 10% per annum, by how much does compound interest exceed simple interest on Rs 540000?
Warehouse planning case — A geometric sequence has first term 5 and common ratio 2. What is its 8th term?
Training-centre exercise — A geometric sequence has first term 7 and common ratio 4. What is its 6th term?
Survey-unit review — After a 10% discount and then 5% sales tax, an equipment bill for a survey unit is Rs 35910. What was the listed price?
questions.e: If L is the list price, L × 90/100 × 105/100 = 35910, giving L = 38000.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — After a 10% discount and then 5% sales tax, an equipment bill for a relief camp is Rs 54810. What was the listed price?
questions.e: If L is the list price, L × 90/100 × 105/100 = 54810, giving L = 58000.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — An investment grows to Rs 12584 in two years at 10% compound interest per year. What was the principal?
District-office worksheet — An investment grows to Rs 15552 in two years at 20% compound interest per year. What was the principal?
Warehouse planning case — The mean of 14 observations in a report is 41. One entry, 31, is corrected to 59. What is the corrected mean?
questions.e: The total rises by 28; divided across 14 observations, the mean rises by 2 to 43.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — The mean of 13 observations in a report is 40. One entry, 30, is corrected to 56. What is the corrected mean?
questions.e: The total rises by 26; divided across 13 observations, the mean rises by 2 to 42.

questions.q: District-office worksheet — 32 passengers paid Rs 1540. An adult ticket cost Rs 55 and a child ticket Rs 35. How many adults travelled?
questions.e: If a is the adult count, 55a + 35(32 − a) = 1540, which gives a = 21.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — 36 passengers paid Rs 2080. An adult ticket cost Rs 65 and a child ticket Rs 45. How many adults travelled?
questions.e: If a is the adult count, 65a + 45(36 − a) = 2080, which gives a = 23.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — A train 140 m long clears a 100 m platform in 12 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
questions.e: The train covers 240 m. Its speed is (240)/12 m/s × 3.6 = 72 km/h.

questions.q: Transport-depot calculation — A train 180 m long clears a 140 m platform in 16 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
questions.e: The train covers 320 m. Its speed is (320)/16 m/s × 3.6 = 72 km/h.

questions.q: Transport-depot calculation — A two-digit number has digit sum 7; reversing its digits increases it by 45. What is the original number?
questions.e: Let the tens and units digits be x and y. Then x + y = 7 and 9(x − y) = -45; hence x = 1, y = 6.

questions.q: Health-programme report — A two-digit number has digit sum 8; reversing its digits increases it by 54. What is the original number?
questions.e: Let the tens and units digits be x and y. Then x + y = 8 and 9(x − y) = -54; hence x = 1, y = 7.

questions.q: Survey-unit review — a survey unit divides 448 files between teams A and B in the ratio 3:5. How many additional files must A receive for the new ratio A:B to become 6:5?
questions.e: The original shares are 168 and 280. To make A's share 336, it needs 336 − 168 = 168 more files.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — Two pipes can fill a tank in 612 and 918 minutes, while a leak can empty it in 1836 minutes. If all three remain open, when will the tank fill?
questions.e: Net rate = 1/612 + 1/918 − 1/1836 = 1/459, so the tank fills in 459 minutes.

questions.q: Health-programme report — a health programme divides 826 files between teams A and B in the ratio 6:8. How many additional files must A receive for the new ratio A:B to become 12:8?
questions.e: The original shares are 354 and 472. To make A's share 708, it needs 708 − 354 = 354 more files.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — Two pipes can fill a tank in 624 and 936 minutes, while a leak can empty it in 1872 minutes. If all three remain open, when will the tank fill?
questions.e: Net rate = 1/624 + 1/936 − 1/1872 = 1/468, so the tank fills in 468 minutes.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — Two triangles are similar. A side of 5 cm in the smaller corresponds to 25 cm in the larger. If another smaller side is 4 cm, what is its corresponding larger side?
questions.e: The scale factor is 25/5 = 5; therefore 4 × 5 = 20 cm.

questions.q: Transport-depot calculation — Two runners start together in opposite directions on a 580 m circular track at 72.5 m/s and 58 m/s. After how many seconds do they first meet?
questions.e: In opposite directions their relative speed is 130.5 m/s, so time is 580 ÷ 130.5 = 4.44 seconds.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — Two triangles are similar. A side of 6 cm in the smaller corresponds to 36 cm in the larger. If another smaller side is 5 cm, what is its corresponding larger side?
questions.e: The scale factor is 36/6 = 6; therefore 5 × 6 = 30 cm.

questions.q: Health-programme report — Two runners start together in opposite directions on a 600 m circular track at 150 m/s and 100 m/s. After how many seconds do they first meet?
questions.e: In opposite directions their relative speed is 250 m/s, so time is 600 ÷ 250 = 2.4 seconds.

questions.q: Survey-unit review — A tank contains 190 litres of a 25% solution. 38 litres of the mixture are removed and replaced by water. What is the new concentration?
questions.e: Removing one-fifth of a uniform mixture removes one-fifth of its solute. The remaining concentration is 25% × 4/5 = 20%.

questions.q: Training-centre exercise — A tank contains 200 litres of a 30% solution. 40 litres of the mixture are removed and replaced by water. What is the new concentration?
questions.e: Removing one-fifth of a uniform mixture removes one-fifth of its solute. The remaining concentration is 30% × 4/5 = 24%.

questions.q: Survey-unit review — a survey unit must select 5 representatives from 7 eligible people. If order does not matter, how many different committees are possible?
Training-centre exercise — a training centre must select 2 representatives from 8 eligible people. If order does not matter, how many different committees are possible?
Scholarship-fund audit — A bus leaves a scholarship fund at 40 km/h. 3 hours later, a car follows on the same route at 54 km/h. How long after the car starts will it catch the bus?
questions.e: The bus has a 120 km lead. Relative speed is 14 km/h, so catch-up time is 8.57 hours.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — A bus leaves a warehouse at 41 km/h. 4 hours later, a car follows on the same route at 56 km/h. How long after the car starts will it catch the bus?
questions.e: The bus has a 164 km lead. Relative speed is 15 km/h, so catch-up time is 10.93 hours.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — What is the least number greater than 156 that leaves remainder 11 when divided by both 12 and 13, given that 12 and 13 are coprime?
questions.e: A common remainder means N − 11 is a multiple of lcm(12, 13) = 156. The least eligible N is 156 + 11 = 167.

questions.q: Warehouse planning case — What is the least number greater than 182 that leaves remainder 12 when divided by both 13 and 14, given that 13 and 14 are coprime?
questions.e: A common remainder means N − 12 is a multiple of lcm(13, 14) = 182. The least eligible N is 182 + 12 = 194.

questions.q: Transport-depot calculation — A boat's still-water speed is 24 km/h and the stream flows at 6 km/h. How long does a 1620 km upstream and 1620 km downstream round trip take?
Health-programme report — A boat's still-water speed is 25 km/h and the stream flows at 2 km/h. How long does a 621 km upstream and 621 km downstream round trip take?
Warehouse planning case — A quarterly table for a warehouse records 230, 135, and 110 completed cases in three months. What percentage of the three-month total was completed in the first month?
questions.e: The total is 475; the first-month share is 230/475 × 100 = 48.42%.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — A quarterly table for a scholarship fund records 220, 130, and 105 completed cases in three months. What percentage of the three-month total was completed in the first month?
questions.e: The total is 455; the first-month share is 220/455 × 100 = 48.35%.

questions.q: Relief-camp planning case — A supplier wants a 20% profit on an item costing Rs 8000, even after allowing a 20% discount on its marked price. What marked price is required?
questions.e: Required selling price is 8000 × 120/100. Since that is 80% of the marked price, divide it by 0.8.

questions.q: District-office worksheet — A supplier wants a 25% profit on an item costing Rs 8800, even after allowing a 25% discount on its marked price. What marked price is required?
questions.e: Required selling price is 8800 × 125/100. Since that is 75% of the marked price, divide it by 0.75.

questions.q: District-office worksheet — A can complete a project in 24 days and B in 36 days. They work together for 12 days; B then leaves. How many days from the start will A take to finish the project?
questions.e: Together they complete 12 × (1/24 + 1/36) = 5/6. A needs another 4 days for the remaining 1/6, totalling 16.

questions.q: Scholarship-fund audit — A can complete a project in 36 days and B in 54 days. They work together for 18 days; B then leaves. How many days from the start will A take to finish the project?
questions.e: Together they complete 18 × (1/36 + 1/54) = 5/6. A needs another 6 days for the remaining 1/6, totalling 24.

questions.q:
Read the passage: “A town announced free museum entry on Sundays. Attendance rose sharply, but the museum also opened a new exhibition that month. The director said the fee change was promising and requested another period of observation after the exhibition ended.”

Why was the director cautious?
o: The new exhibition could also have attracted visitors
questions.e: The exhibition changed at the same time as the fee.

questions.q:
Read the passage: “A town announced free museum entry on Sundays. Attendance rose sharply, but the museum also opened a new exhibition that month. The director said the fee change was promising and requested another period of observation after the exhibition ended.”

What would the later observation help distinguish?
o: The cost of repainting the museum
The price of tickets in another town
The effect of free entry from a temporary exhibition effect
questions.e: Observing after the exhibition ends removes one competing explanation.

questions.q: ان اصطلاحات—حرفِ اختصاص و شرکت، حرفِ فجائیہ، حرفِ ندا، حرفِ جواب—میں درست اصطلاح اور تعریف کا جوڑا منتخب کریں۔
o: حرفِ جواب — جو اچانک واقعہ یا حیرت ظاہر کرے۔
حرفِ اختصاص و شرکت — جو کسی چیز کی خصوصیت یا شمولیت کو ظاہر کرے۔
حرفِ فجائیہ — جو کسی کو پکارنے کے لیے استعمال ہو۔
حرفِ ندا — جو سوال یا بات کے جواب میں استعمال ہو۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 212: حرفِ اختصاص و شرکت — جو کسی چیز کی خصوصیت یا شمولیت کو ظاہر کرے۔

questions.q: “ماضی مطلق” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: سادہ ماضی، جس میں وقت کا تعین نہ ہو - صرف یہ بتایا جائے کہ کام ہو چکا ہے۔
ایسا ماضی جو خواہش یا شرط کے اظہار کے لیے ہو، حقیقت میں واقع نہ ہوا ہو
غیر (ایسا ماضی جو شاید یا ممکن ہے کہ ہوا ہو )یقینی یا قیاسی
جو ماضی میں کسی مدت تک جاری رہا ہو۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 211: ماضی مطلق — سادہ ماضی، جس میں وقت کا تعین نہ ہو - صرف یہ بتایا جائے کہ کام ہو چکا ہے۔

questions.q: یہ تعریف کس اصطلاح کی ہے؟ “مخصوص الفاظ میں زیر کی خاص صورت۔”

questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 208: اسمِ مفعول — جو کسی کام کا نشانہ بننے والے پر دلالت کرے

questions.q: تعریف “وہ حرف جو دو الفاظ یا جملوں کو مالئے” اور مثال “اور، بلکہ، یا” کس اصطلاح کو ظاہر کرتی ہیں؟
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 211: ۔ حرف عطف — وہ حرف جو دو الفاظ یا جملوں کو مالئے

questions.q: تعریف “وہ فعل جو موجودہ وقت میں ہو رہا ہو۔” اور مثال “وہ کھیلتا ہے، میں پڑھتا ہوں” کس اصطلاح کو ظاہر کرتی ہیں؟
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 211: فعل حال — وہ فعل جو موجودہ وقت میں ہو رہا ہو۔

questions.q: ان اصطلاحات—خطاب، لقب، کنیت، عرف—میں درست اصطلاح اور تعریف کا جوڑا منتخب کریں۔
o: کنیت — وہ اسم جو کسی شخص کی پہچان یا عزت کے لئے غیر رسمی طور پر استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔
لقب — وہ اسم جو کسی شخص کے والد یا بچوں کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے۔
خطاب — وہ اسم جو کسی شخص کو عزت یا احترام سے پکارنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔
عرف — وہ اسم جو کسی شخص کو کسی خاص خصوصیت یا حیثیت کی وجہ سے دیا جاتا ہے۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 209: خطاب — وہ اسم جو کسی شخص کو عزت یا احترام سے پکارنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

questions.q: یہ تعریف کس اصطلاح کی ہے؟ “وہ لفظ جو کسی کام یا حالت کو ظاہر کرے”
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 208: فعل — وہ لفظ جو کسی کام یا حالت کو ظاہر کرے

questions.q: “اسمِ حالیہّ” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: وہ اسم جو کسی خاص شخص، مقام، یا چیز کا نام ہو۔
وہ اسم جو کسی شخص یا چیز کی جگہ پر آتا ہے۔
وہ اسم جو کسی چیز یا شخص کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہو۔
جو فاعل یا مفعول کی حالت یا کیفیت کو ظاہر کرے
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 209: اسمِ حالیہّ — جو فاعل یا مفعول کی حالت یا کیفیت کو ظاہر کرے

questions.q: “تشدید” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: حرکت کو لمبا کر کے پڑھنا
امال کے لحاظ سے کسی لفظ میں الف یا ی کو بڑی ے میں تبدیل کرنا۔
حرف کو دہُرا اور زور سے ادا کرنے کی عالمت۔
وقف کی صورت میں لفظ کا آخری حرف ساکن ہو جاتا ہے۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 213: تشدید — حرف کو دہُرا اور زور سے ادا کرنے کی عالمت۔

questions.q: ان اصطلاحات—حرو فِ قمریة، متحرک اور ساکن میں فرق، زبر، زیر—میں درست اصطلاح اور تعریف کا جوڑا منتخب کریں۔
o: زیر — متحرک: جس حرف پر حرکت (زبر، زیر، پیش) ہو۔ساکن: جس پر کوئی حرکت نہ ہو بلکہ جزم ہو۔
زبر — نیچے کی چھوٹی لکیر جو آواز کو نیچے التی ہے۔
متحرک اور ساکن میں فرق — اوپر کی چھوٹی لکیر جو آواز کو کھولتی ہے۔
حرو فِ قمریة — کل: 51 ایسے حروف جن کے ساتھ "ال" لگانے پر "ل" واضح پڑھی جاتی ہے
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 213: حرو فِ قمریة — کل: 51 ایسے حروف جن کے ساتھ "ال" لگانے پر "ل" واضح پڑھی جاتی ہے

questions.q: “مصدر” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: جو کسی اور لفظ (خاص طور پر مصدر) سے بنا ہو
جو کسی حقیقی وجود رکھنے والی چیز یا فرد پر دلالت کرے
وہ اسم جس میں مصدر کی کیفیت یا اثر پایا جائے
ایسا اسم جو کسی کام کے کرنے یا ہونے کے معنی دے
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 208: مصدر — ایسا اسم جو کسی کام کے کرنے یا ہونے کے معنی دے

questions.q: “عددی” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: حروف کا ایسا مجموعہ جو بولا جائے، چاہے اس کا مطلب ہو یا نہ ہو۔
وہ صفت جو کسی ضمیر کے ذریعے کسی اسم کی طرف اشارہ کرے۔
وہ صفت جو کسی چیز کی مقدار یا پیمانہ ظاہر کرے۔
وہ صفت جو کسی چیز کی تعداد ظاہر کرے۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 210: عددی — وہ صفت جو کسی چیز کی تعداد ظاہر کرے۔

questions.q: “مذکر” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: جو ایک سے زیادہ چیزوں یا افراد پر دلالت کرے
جو ایک چیز یا فرد پر دلالت کرے
جو عورت یا مادہ پر دلالت کرے
جو مرد یا نر پر دلالت کرے
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 208: مذکر — جو مرد یا نر پر دلالت کرے

questions.q:
Read the passage: “A committee received two cost estimates for a new school. The cheaper estimate excluded maintenance, while the dearer included repairs over five years. Members asked for estimates on the same basis before choosing a contractor.”

What does “on the same basis” imply here?
o: Using a common scope and time period
questions.e: Comparable estimates must include the same cost categories and period.

questions.q:
Read the passage: “A committee received two cost estimates for a new school. The cheaper estimate excluded maintenance, while the dearer included repairs over five years. Members asked for estimates on the same basis before choosing a contractor.”

Why were the original estimates not directly comparable?
o: Both were prepared by one contractor
They covered different categories of cost
questions.e: Maintenance was included in only one estimate.

The teacher ordered the students to stand up not.

The economist said that inflation was rising.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “He asked, ’Where is the committee meeting?’”?

He asked where the committee was meeting.

He was deprived of his rights and was not eligible for the allowance.
He were deprived of his rights and was not eligible for the allowance.

o: She asked if I liked chocolate.
He asked where I was going.
He asked if I was coming.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “The officer asked why did the file get delayed.”?

The secretary ordered them to reduce expenditure immediately.

This is the worst decision the cabinet have ever made.
This is the worst decision the cabinet has ever made.
This is the worse decision the cabinet has ever made.

questions.e: مصلحت کا تعلق مناسب تدبیر اور بہتری سے ہے۔

questions.q: ان اصطلاحات—اسمِ حالیہّ، اسمِ علم، ضمیر، اسمِ اشارہ—میں درست اصطلاح اور تعریف کا جوڑا منتخب کریں۔
o: اسمِ حالیہّ — جو فاعل یا مفعول کی حالت یا کیفیت کو ظاہر کرے
اسمِ علم — وہ اسم جو کسی شخص یا چیز کی جگہ پر آتا ہے۔
ضمیر — وہ اسم جو کسی چیز یا شخص کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہو۔
اسمِ اشارہ — وہ اسم جو کسی خاص شخص، مقام، یا چیز کا نام ہو۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 209: اسمِ حالیہّ — جو فاعل یا مفعول کی حالت یا کیفیت کو ظاہر کرے

questions.q: یہ تعریف کس اصطلاح کی ہے؟ “جس میں حال (وصفی کیفیت) اور اس کا حامل ساتھ ہوں۔”
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 214: مرک بِ حال و ذوالحال — جس میں حال (وصفی کیفیت) اور اس کا حامل ساتھ ہوں۔

questions.q: تعریف “وہ لفظ جو کسی کام یا حالت کو ظاہر کرے” اور مثال “آیا، جاتا ہے، پڑھے گا” کس اصطلاح کو ظاہر کرتی ہیں؟
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 208: فعل — وہ لفظ جو کسی کام یا حالت کو ظاہر کرے

questions.q: یہ تعریف کس اصطلاح کی ہے؟ “جو کسی معاوضے، اجرت یا مزدوری کے لیے استعمال ہو”
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 209: اسمِ معاوضہ — جو کسی معاوضے، اجرت یا مزدوری کے لیے استعمال ہو

questions.q: یہ تعریف کس اصطلاح کی ہے؟ “وہ صفت جو کسی چیز یا شخص کا تعلق یا نسبت ظاہر کرے۔”
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 210: نسبتی — وہ صفت جو کسی چیز یا شخص کا تعلق یا نسبت ظاہر کرے۔

questions.q: “مرک بِ عط فِ بیان و مبین” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: ایک لفظ کی تاکید کے لیے دوسرا لفظ استعمال ہو۔
اسم کی مزید وضاحت کرنے والا دوسرا اسم۔
حرفِ جار اور اسم پر مشتمل۔
کسی شے کو جملے سے علیحدہ کرنے کا عمل۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 214: مرک بِ عط فِ بیان و مبین — اسم کی مزید وضاحت کرنے والا دوسرا اسم۔

questions.q: یہ تعریف کس اصطلاح کی ہے؟ “جو خوشی یا وسع تِ دل کے اظہار کے لیے ہو۔”
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 212: حرفِ انبساط — جو خوشی یا وسع تِ دل کے اظہار کے لیے ہو۔

questions.q: یہ تعریف کس اصطلاح کی ہے؟ “ملکیت ظاہر کرے (کسی چیز کا مالک کون ہے)”
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 214: تملیکی — ملکیت ظاہر کرے (کسی چیز کا مالک کون ہے)

questions.q: یہ تعریف کس اصطلاح کی ہے؟ “نیچے کی چھوٹی لکیر جو آواز کو نیچے التی ہے۔”
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 213: زیر — نیچے کی چھوٹی لکیر جو آواز کو نیچے التی ہے۔

questions.q: “حرفِ ندا” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: جو کسی کو پکارنے کے لیے استعمال ہو۔
جو سوال یا بات کے جواب میں استعمال ہو۔
جو خوشی یا وسع تِ دل کے اظہار کے لیے ہو۔
جو حیرت یا تعجب ظاہر کرے۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 212: حرفِ ندا — جو کسی کو پکارنے کے لیے استعمال ہو۔

questions.q: “حرو فِ قمریة” کی درست تعریف منتخب کریں۔
o: کل: 51 ایسے حروف جن کے ساتھ "ال" لگانے پر "ل" واضح پڑھی جاتی ہے
نیچے کی چھوٹی لکیر جو آواز کو نیچے التی ہے۔
اوپر کی چھوٹی لکیر جو آواز کو کھولتی ہے۔
متحرک: جس حرف پر حرکت (زبر، زیر، پیش) ہو۔ساکن: جس پر کوئی حرکت نہ ہو بلکہ جزم ہو۔
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 213: حرو فِ قمریة — کل: 51 ایسے حروف جن کے ساتھ "ال" لگانے پر "ل" واضح پڑھی جاتی ہے

questions.q: ان اصطلاحات—امالہ، ادغام، محذوف، حرو فِ صحیح—میں درست اصطلاح اور تعریف کا جوڑا منتخب کریں۔
o: ادغام — وہ حرف یا حرکت جو موجود تو ہو مگر تلفظ میں نہ آئے۔
امالہ — امال کے لحاظ سے کسی لفظ میں الف یا ی کو بڑی ے میں تبدیل کرنا۔
حرو فِ صحیح — دو ہم آواز حروف کو مال کر ایک ساتھ پڑھنا یا لکھنا۔
محذوف — وہ حروف جن کا تلفظ صاف، واضح اور مکمل ہوتا ہے
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 213: امالہ — امال کے لحاظ سے کسی لفظ میں الف یا ی کو بڑی ے میں تبدیل کرنا۔

questions.q: تعریف “اسم کی مزید وضاحت کرنے والا دوسرا اسم۔” اور مثال “ابو بکر صدیق” کس اصطلاح کو ظاہر کرتی ہیں؟
o: مرک بِ مستثنیٰ و مستثنیٰ منہ
مرک بِ عط فِ بیان و مبین
questions.e: ذخیرۂ قواعد، ماخذ صفحہ 214: مرک بِ عط فِ بیان و مبین — اسم کی مزید وضاحت کرنے والا دوسرا اسم۔

questions.q:
Read the passage: “A bank invited customers to use an automated helpline. Straightforward questions were resolved faster, but complicated complaints often required repeated calls. The bank added a route to a trained adviser after the first unsuccessful attempt.”

What problem did the new route address?
o: A ban on all automated answers
The need to close the bank
questions.e: Complex cases were poorly served by repeated automation.

questions.q:
Read the passage: “A bank invited customers to use an automated helpline. Straightforward questions were resolved faster, but complicated complaints often required repeated calls. The bank added a route to a trained adviser after the first unsuccessful attempt.”

Which policy is most consistent with the passage?
o: Use automation for every case without exception
Match the response channel to the complexity of the case
questions.e: Routine and complex matters require different levels of support.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Definition “Shows location” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 230: Type “Preposition of Place” corresponds to Definition “Shows location”.

questions.q: Which Type is associated with Example Word “either...or” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 231: Type “Correlative Conjunction” corresponds to Example Word “either...or”.

questions.q: Which revision is grammatical and preserves the intended meaning of “Corruption is high. Trust is low. Reform is needed. (Combine with flow.)”?
o: Corruption is not high and trust is low; serious reform is therefore needed.
Corruption is high. Trust is low. Reform is needed. (Combine with flow.)
Corruption is high and trust is low; serious reform is therefore needed.
Corruption are high and trust is low; serious reform is therefore needed.
questions.e: Corruption is high and trust is low; serious reform is therefore needed. (Cohesion/flow Days 17, 26.)

questions.q: Which Tense is associated with Example “She is writing now.” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 244: Tense “Present Continuous” corresponds to Example “She is writing now.”.

questions.q: Which Tense is associated with Structure “subject + had been + verb-ing” in the English reference?
questions.e: Repository English reference, page 244: Tense “Past Perfect Continuous” corresponds to Structure “subject + had been + verb-ing”.

questions.s: Future forms and the sequence of tenses
questions.q: The conference ____ on 12 April according to the published schedule.
questions.e: A published timetable takes the present simple.
